title: News Writer / Journalist
description:
Title:  News Writer / Journalist

Location:  Remote – Philippines

Hours:  Shift options: UK, North American, or Australian market hours

Reporting to:  Managing Editor / News Desk Lead

Contract Type:  Contractor



About Proactive

Proactive is a global multimedia organisation and the leading provider of real-time AI-integrated media, analytics and market data tools to issuers globally. Working with over 1,800 clients across the UK, US, Canada and Australia, Proactive delivers breaking news, video interviews, podcasts, investor forums, sponsored research and behavioural marketing campaigns that drive stakeholder awareness and engagement.

Through our proprietary NewsifAI™ platform and SaaS data tools, we are building the world’s most advanced AI-enabled financial news desk – combining speed, accuracy and editorial quality at scale.



Position Summary

Proactive is building a new global AI-enabled news desk and we are looking for financially literate reporters who can write fast, think clearly and work confidently alongside AI production tools. You will cover breaking news on UK, North American and ASX-listed companies, with a focus on junior resources, biotech, energy and small-cap growth stocks. You understand why company news moves share prices – and you can explain it to investors clearly and quickly.



Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Reporting to the Managing Editor, the News Writer / Journalist will:

- Write fast, accurate and engaging news articles covering UK, North American and ASX-listed public companies

- Utilise Proactive’s proprietary NewsifAI™ tools and other AI production platforms to enhance speed and output quality

- Monitor RNS, newswire and exchange announcements across global markets during assigned shift hours

- Identify and communicate why company news moves share prices, with a focus on junior resources, biotech, energy and small-cap growth stocks

- Ensure all content meets Proactive editorial standards for accuracy, clarity and SEO performance

- Maintain strong social media literacy, supporting distribution of content across digital channels

- Meet daily output targets and deadlines in a fast-paced, remote newsroom environment



Person Specification – Skills and Experience Required

- 2+ years of reporting experience covering public companies or financial markets (or a journalism degree for entry-level applicants)

- Familiarity with AI tools including large language models (LLMs) and AI-assisted writing platforms

- Strong written English – fast, clear and investor-focused

- Social media literacy and understanding of digital content distribution

- SEO awareness and understanding of how to optimise financial news content

- Knowledge of the resources sector (mining, energy, metals) is a significant advantage

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment across time zones



Work Environment – What We Offer

- A front-row seat at the intersection of financial journalism and AI – shaping how news is made

- Remote, flexible working with shifts aligned to your chosen market (UK, North America or Australia)

- The opportunity to work with one of the best-known names in global financial media, trusted by over 1,800 listed companies

- Access to Proactive’s proprietary AI newsroom tools and technology stack

- A collaborative, fast-moving global team environment



How to Apply



If you are fast, accurate and curious about where AI-assisted journalism is heading, we want to hear from you.

Send your CV and two recent clips to: 

Please include your contact details, availability and the market shift (UK / North America / Australia) you are applying for.

Due to the expected volume of applications, we regret that we may be unable to respond to candidates who are not invited to interview.

title: Acquisition Specialist – Cold Caller & Closer
description:
Acquisition Specialist – Cold Caller & Closer



(Single Point of Accountability | Performance-Only | Zero Handoffs)



WARNING:

Apply only if you have verified experience in both outbound cold calling and direct-to-seller closing. If you require handoffs, coaching, or flexible standards, this is not for you.



Role Overview



You are solely responsible for generating, qualifying, and closing distressed property deals (unpaid taxes, inheritance, title issues, problem properties).

You will be measured and retained based exclusively on daily call output, pipeline quality, and contracts closed—no exceptions.



Your Responsibilities



100+ live cold call conversations per day (not dials—actual conversations logged and recorded)



Immediate qualification/disqualification using a fixed criteria set—no “relationship building” without outcome



Full-cycle deal management: Personally negotiate, contract, and close each deal—no handoffs at any stage



Accurate, real-time CRM entry for every contact, note, and pipeline movement



Follow strict process: All activity and results tracked and audited. Miss metrics for any reason = immediate removal



Who You Must Be



Proven in both cold calling (high daily volume) and full-cycle closing (real estate or equivalent asset class)



Able to provide daily metrics and references—not negotiable



Rigid about pipeline management, documentation, and transparent reporting



Comfortable with direct feedback and negative coaching—no sensitivity to high-rejection or blunt performance management



Compensation-driven, with a clear history of thriving under performance-only pay plans



Immediate Disqualifiers



No resume or lack of specific metrics for calls/deals



No voice memo, or memo not following exact instructions below



History of team-selling, “split” process roles, or reluctance to own the full sales cycle



Evidence of missed quotas, resistance to feedback, or incomplete reporting



Application Process



1. Submit your resume clearly listing outbound + closing experience, including your highest daily call volume and annual closed deals.

2. Submit a 2–3 minute, unscripted voice memo (no script, no edits) covering, in order:



Your name, country, and highest daily cold call volume in a sales role



An example of a distressed or complicated deal you personally closed (describe steps and outcome)



Your personal system for tracking activity, pipeline, and follow-ups



The most direct/negative feedback you’ve received about your sales process and what changed after



Why you want a single-point, output-only sales role (not team selling or account management)



Any deviation from these steps = immediate rejection.



Do Not Apply If:



You lack both cold calling and direct closing experience with provable metrics



You need daily encouragement, “culture,” or ongoing training

title: Acquisitions Closer – Real Estate
description:
Acquisitions Closer – Real Estate 



Are you process-driven, direct, and energized by real conversations?

We’re looking for a disciplined outbound sales professional based in the Philippines to connect with property owners facing urgent, complex situations—delinquent taxes, inherited estates, title issues, and more. Our sellers aren’t just “leads”—they’re people in transition who need straight answers and real solutions.



This is not a basic call center job.

If you’re skilled at asking the right questions, unafraid of hearing “no,” and want your compensation to reflect your results—not just your effort—read on.



Role Overview:



Primary focus: Outbound calling to distressed property owners—cold calls, follow-ups, and active pipeline management.



Objective: Uncover seller motivation, determine property fit, and guide owners to a clear outcome (offers or next steps).



Daily routine: High phone activity, rapid qualification, disciplined follow-up, accurate notes.



Pace: High volume, high accountability. Activity and results are tracked and reviewed.



Compensation Structure:



Base pay: Modest, for reliability.



Commission: Significant; your earnings scale with your results.



No ceiling: Top performers set their own income.



Underperformance: Addressed quickly—excuses are not accepted.



Environment & Expectations:



You control your own pipeline—but are measured daily.



Calls are monitored, results are tracked, and feedback is regular.



If you thrive in a disciplined, no-excuses culture, you’ll succeed here.

What We’re Looking For:



Resilience: Can you keep dialing and qualifying, no matter how many rejections?



Clarity: Can you speak directly, ask difficult questions, and move conversations toward a decision?



Self-management: Do you measure your own output and seek improvement—without constant reminders?



Motivation: Are you truly driven by the opportunity to control your income?



Application Instructions – Read Carefully

Your name and most relevant phone sales experience.

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description:
Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it.



REQUIRED: 

1) MUST have industrial piping estimation including labor takeoff from piping ISOs.

2) Can work roughly 4-8pm EST, Mon-Thurs



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

- QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts

- Do independent manual material take-offs (MTO) from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy

- Count welds and do labor takeoff from ISOs, which means genuinely interpreting the drawings, not just counting symbols

- Build clean bills of materials (BOM) and document errors so our engineers can fix them

- Help us understand where the software falls short of what a real estimator would catch



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Industrial Piping Estimators

- Real experience doing material AND labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome

- You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. P&ID experience is a plus, not required

- Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team

- Strong Excel skills. AutoCAD experience is a plus

-Part time and full time are both a possibility





OUR HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live.



WHY JOIN

- Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up

- Work directly with the founders and engineering team

- Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence



TO APPLY

Tell us briefly about your experience doing material and labor takeoffs from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

title: Logistics Support Specialist
description:
Role Summary: 

The Logistics Support Specialist provides administrative and operational support to the Logistics Department in managing order fulfillment, transportation coordination, core returns, and warranty-related logistics activities. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate records, coordinating documentation, updating internal systems, monitoring shipment status, and supporting day-to-day logistics operations to ensure timely and efficient execution of business processes.



Core Responsibilities: 

- Provide administrative support for the logistics department to the entire logistics department.

- Prepare, organize, and maintain logistics documentation, records, and shipment files.

- Create, update, and monitor shipment records in company systems and trackers.

- Coordinate shipment scheduling and communicate with carriers, customers, vendors, and internal departments as needed.

- Track shipment status and provide updates to relevant stakeholders.

- Assist in processing shipping documents including Bills of Lading (BOL), Proofs of Delivery (POD), carrier confirmations, and related records.

- Maintain accurate records of serial numbers, shipment details, return information, and supporting documentation.

- Monitor open logistics transactions and follow up on pending items to ensure timely completion.

- Support warranty and core return processes by collecting, organizing, and updating required documentation and records.

- Assist with freight-related inquiries, documentation requests, and issue resolution.

- Ensure logistics files and records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with company procedures.

- Prepare reports, summaries, and administrative documentation as requested by management.

- Perform other logistics and administrative support duties as assigned



Qualifications:

- Minimum of 5 years of professional work experience, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in logistics administration, transportation support, supply chain coordination, or a similar logistics-related role supporting U.S. operations.

- Experience working with shipping documentation, transportation coordination, order processing, or logistics administration.

- Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

- Proficient in Google Suits, Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams.



Relevant qualifications are an advantage but not required:

- Experience supporting order fulfillment, transportation, or warehouse-related processes 

-  Strong knowledge and experience in US LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) Logistics

- Familiarity with freight, carrier coordination, shipment tracking, and logistics documentation

title: GoHighLevel Systems Specialist — Complete Existing Build
description:
TintGard is an Australian window tinting company specialising in automotive, residential and commercial window tinting. We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to take over and complete an existing GHL build and bring it to production-ready launch within 2 weeks. A significant amount of the system has already been built. We are not looking for a complete rebuild from scratch. The successful specialist will review what currently exists, retain what is working correctly, fix or improve what is required, and complete the remaining system. This is not a basic GHL setup or VA role. We are looking for someone who has personally built and launched sophisticated GHL systems for service businesses.



The objective

Complete TintGard OS so it manages the customer lifecycle across our three divisions:

Automotive | Residential | Commercial/Office

The overall journey covers:

Lead capture - qualification/nurturing - quote or online purchase - booking - job completion - aftercare - customer experience - reviews - referrals - reactivation - lifetime customer



- GoHighLevel is our CRM, sales, marketing, AI and customer lifecycle platform.

- ServiceM8 remains our operational platform for quotes, work orders, scheduling, jobs, invoicing and payments.



Key technical requirements

You need proven capability in:

* Advanced GoHighLevel customer lifecycle automation

* Taking over, auditing and completing an existing GHL build

* GHL, ServiceM8 or comparable job-management integrations

* APIs, webhooks and 
/Zapier/n8n

* GHL Conversational AI / AI Agents

* Website and GHL integration

* Landing pages and funnels

* Online/instant quoting pathways

* Online shopping, checkout and payment pathways

* Forms, surveys and customer experience journeys

* Multi-channel lead capture and communication

* CRM/database architecture and segmentation

* Quote follow-up, objection handling and sales recovery automation

* Review, referral and reactivation systems

* Large historical customer database import/segmentation

* Reporting and management dashboards

* Error monitoring, exception handling and failed-integration alerts

* End-to-end testing and production deployment



One particularly important requirement is system reliability. We need someone who understands how to identify and protect against workflows, webhooks and integrations failing silently. The finished system must be built specifically around TintGard's operating processes, not simply be a generic GHL snapshot. 



Existing build

You will be taking over an existing partial implementation.

Your job is to:

Understand it - validate it - retain what works - fix what doesn't - complete what is missing - test the entire customer lifecycle - launch it.

Existing documentation and the detailed TintGard OS scope will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Project terms



Fixed project: A$500

Completion: 2 weeks



Please only apply if you have the technical experience and availability to deliver within these terms. To apply

Please provide:

1. Examples of complete GHL systems you have personally built and launched.

2. A Loom/video walkthrough of a GHL system you personally implemented.

, Zapier or n8n.

8. Your experience with database reactivation and large contact databases.

10. Only apply if you can commence promptly and complete the project within 2 weeks for the fixed A$500 project price.

title: Shopee & Lazada Shop Assistant (Listings, Shop Management & Content)
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented virtual assistant to manage our Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, and Amazon store full-time. This is a 3-month trial with strong potential to become a permanent role for the right person.



Core responsibilities:

Create new product listings from photos we provide — write titles/descriptions, generate product videos using AI tools (training provided), and upload across all four platforms.

Maintain shop decoration/storefront design (banners, layout) using each platform's built-in shop decoration editor, Affinity, and Canva.

Monitor stock levels and flag when reorders are needed before we run out.

Respond to buyer chat messages and handle basic order/return queries.

Keep an eye on ad campaign performance (Shopee GMV Max / Lazada Sponsored Max) and flag anything unusual — we'll set the targets.



Weekly listing targets: 8–10 completed listings/week for the first 2 weeks while we clear the current backlog, then 3–5/week afterward as the role shifts more toward day-to-day shop management. Targets account for the fact that listings are only part of the role, not the whole job.



What we're looking for: prior experience with Shopee/Lazada Seller Center (must), comfort learning AI content tools, strong written English for buyer chat, and someone organized enough to track inventory without being chased. Candidates with an artistic or design background (e.g. graphic design, photo/video editing, Canva or Affinity proficiency) will have an advantage, since the role includes shop decoration and content styling.



To apply: along with your application, please attach one sample of your design work — this can be a shop banner mockup, an edited product photo, or a short video you've created.



Selection process: shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test task, followed by a final paid trial round for top candidates, before starting the full 3-month engagement.



All required tools and software (AI content generation, Canva/Affinity, inventory tracking, seller center access) will be provided — no need to purchase anything yourself.



Payment terms: during the 3-month engagement, paid weekly based on completed work and agreed targets, rather than a lump sum. If weekly targets are consistently not met, we reserve the right to end the engagement before the 3-month mark. Candidates who perform well and hit targets will be considered for a permanent role after the trial period.

title: Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist Professional
description:

 .

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Creative Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of ICHOR Performance, a new premium performance brand being built around training, athletics, adventure, and high-performance lifestyle.



We're preparing for launch, and I'm looking for one creative person to grow with the brand long-term.



This is not a generic virtual assistant position.



Your main responsibility will be taking raw footage from me, including founder videos, gym footage, training, business building, lifestyle clips, and product development, and turning it into polished short-form content for Instagram Reels and TikTok.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit approximately 3 to 5 short-form videos per week.



Turn raw talking-head footage into compelling 20 to 60 second stories.



Identify strong hooks and moments without needing exact instructions.



Color correct and grade footage.



Clean and improve audio.



Add captions, music, sound design, B-roll, and tasteful graphics.



Create premium fitness and lifestyle edits.



Help brainstorm content ideas and hooks.



Study successful fitness, lifestyle, founder, and performance brands.



Help develop a recognizable visual style for ICHOR.



Organize completed content and raw footage.



THE STYLE



I'm not looking for overly edited videos filled with emojis, crazy transitions, constant zooms, or giant captions.



The ICHOR aesthetic should feel premium, athletic, cinematic, modern, dark, energetic, and aspirational.



The content should make a young startup feel like a much larger brand.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You genuinely understand TikTok and Reels pacing.



You have excellent visual taste.



You understand fitness and lifestyle content.



You can take messy raw footage and find the story inside it.



You don't need every cut explained to you.



You're willing to suggest better ideas when you see them.



You're reliable and communicate well.



You want a long-term role rather than random freelance projects.



Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Desktop is fine.



Your portfolio matters much more to me than your resume.



COMPENSATION



$400 USD per month to start.



Approximately 12 to 15 flexible hours per week.



This is intended to become a long-term position. As ICHOR grows and you prove yourself, there will be opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility, and potentially a larger creative role within the brand.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ASCEND.



Please send links to the three short-form videos you're most proud of editing.



Tell me which two or three creators or brands you think currently make excellent fitness, lifestyle, or founder content.



Tell me whether you're comfortable receiving around 10 minutes of unscripted raw footage and independently finding the strongest 30 to 60 second story inside it.



Tell me what editing software you primarily use.



Finally, based on the description of ICHOR above, give me one short-form content idea you think the brand should make.



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



I'm primarily evaluating taste, creativity, storytelling, and whether you actually read this posting.



Strong applicants may be invited to complete a paid editing audition using the same raw footage as the other finalists.

title: Social Intelligence & Community Executive
description:
Offshore / Remote



About the Role



Lazywaist is looking for a highly curious and digitally savvy Social Intelligence & Community Executive to be our eyes and ears across social media and online communities.



Your role is to continuously understand what consumers are talking about, what is trending, what competitors are doing, which creators are gaining influence, and where new opportunities are emerging for the brand.



This is not primarily a content creation role.



You will help Lazywaist turn thousands of online conversations into useful insights that influence our content, marketing, partnerships, product development and overall brand strategy.



Key Responsibilities

1. Social & Trend Monitoring



Monitor relevant conversations daily across platforms including:



TikTok

Instagram


Reddit

Lemon8

Xiaohongshu / RED

 and other relevant communities

Forums and online groups



Identify:



Emerging trends

Viral content formats

Popular topics and questions

Consumer behaviours

New terminology and conversations

Potential content opportunities

Changes in sentiment or demand



Focus areas may include:



Shapewear • Postpartum • Pregnancy • Women's Wellness • Pilates • Fitness • Bridal • Fashion • Body Confidence • Recovery



2. Brand Listening



Track conversations and mentions relating to Lazywaist, including those where the brand is not tagged.



Identify:



Customer recommendations

Reviews and feedback

Complaints or concerns

Questions about Lazywaist products

Product comparisons

Purchase considerations

Frequently raised objections

Organic brand advocates



Important conversations should be escalated to the team quickly.



3. Community Intelligence



Join and monitor relevant online communities, forums and group discussions where participation is permitted.



Your responsibility is to understand:



What consumers are asking

Problems they are trying to solve

Products they are recommending

Products they dislike

What they wish existed

Common misconceptions

Purchase triggers

Price sensitivity

Competitor sentiment



Summarise recurring conversations into actionable consumer insights for the Lazywaist team.



4. Community Engagement



Participate in relevant discussions where appropriate and in accordance with each community's rules.



Engagement should always focus on:



Being helpful first. Building trust second. Selling last.



You may:



Answer relevant questions

Provide useful product/category knowledge

Clarify misinformation

Direct customers towards useful resources

Identify conversations where Lazywaist could genuinely help



You must never impersonate a customer or create fake recommendations for Lazywaist. Brand relationships should be disclosed where relevant.



5. Competitor Intelligence



Continuously monitor competitors and adjacent brands.



Track:



New product launches

Pricing and promotions

Best-selling products

Content strategies

Influencer collaborations

Advertising angles

Customer reviews

Customer complaints

Viral posts

Positioning and messaging

Community sentiment



Rather than simply reporting what competitors are doing, explain:



What happened ? Why it matters ? What Lazywaist can learn or do differently.



6. Creator & KOL Research



Identify emerging and established creators who could be relevant to Lazywaist.



Build and maintain a comprehensive creator database including:



Creator name

Social media handle

Platform

Country

Content category

Followers

Average views

Engagement quality

Audience relevance

Previous brand collaborations

Relevant personal/content milestones publicly shared

Contact information where publicly available for business purposes

Existing Lazywaist relationship

Collaboration status

Notes on content style

Recommended collaboration angle



Particular attention should be given to high-potential creators before they become highly commercialised.





Requirements — Social Intelligence & Community Executive



Must-have



1–3 years of experience in social media, community management, influencer/KOL research, digital marketing, consumer research or a related role.

Extremely comfortable navigating TikTok, Instagram,
 Groups, Reddit and online communities.

Strong understanding of social media trends, creator culture and how content spreads.

Excellent online research skills — able to dig beyond the first search result and uncover relevant conversations, creators and brand mentions.

Strong written and spoken English.

Able to read conversations and identify the underlying customer problem, demand or opportunity, rather than simply reporting what was said.

Strong judgement in distinguishing a genuine trend from one viral post.

Comfortable joining and participating in online communities in a natural, helpful and non-spammy manner.

Highly organised and able to maintain databases for creators, competitors, trends and consumer insights.

Able to summarise large amounts of information into clear, concise and actionable recommendations.

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.

Proactive — expected to flag opportunities without waiting to be asked.

Strong attention to detail.

Able to handle commercially sensitive information confidentially.



Strong advantage



Familiarity with the Singapore consumer market, language, slang and social-media culture.

Experience researching Singapore-based creators/KOLs.

Experience with maternity, postpartum, women's wellness, beauty, fashion, fitness or e-commerce brands.

Experience working with TikTok Shop / TikTok LIVE.

Familiarity with tools such as Google Sheets, Excel, Notion, Airtable or social-listening platforms.

Experience conducting competitor analysis or preparing consumer-insight reports.

title: Grant Specialist / Virtual Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an Atlanta-based nonprofit organization dedicated to serving and empowering youth of all ages through programs, resources, and community initiatives. As we grow, we are looking for an experienced Grant Specialist / Virtual Assistant to support our fundraising efforts and help us identify and pursue strong funding opportunities.



About the Role

We are seeking a knowledgeable nonprofit grant professional who can step into an existing grant process and provide research, editing, organization, and strategic support.

Our leadership team develops the ideas, program information, and initial content. We are looking for someone who can take what we have created and make it stronger—not someone who requires us to teach them the fundamentals of grant writing.

The ideal candidate understands what funders look for, can recognize opportunities for improvement, and knows how to make a proposal more compelling while maintaining our organization's authentic voice.



Responsibilities

Research foundation, corporate, government, and community grant opportunities that align with our youth-focused mission

Evaluate funders based on eligibility, priorities, geography, giving history, and overall fit

Review and edit grant proposals, narratives, letters of inquiry, and supporting materials

Strengthen proposals for clarity, organization, impact, and alignment with funder requirements

Identify gaps or weaknesses and recommend specific improvements

Help tailor existing content to individual funders and opportunities

Maintain an organized grant tracker, deadlines, and submission calendar

Help organize supporting documents and application materials

Monitor prospective funding opportunities and help build a strong grant pipeline

Provide constructive feedback and strategic recommendations throughout the grant process



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone with meaningful nonprofit grant experience who can contribute specialized knowledge from day one.

The ideal candidate will:

Have experience with nonprofit grant research, writing, editing, or fundraising

Have contributed to successful grant applications or funded proposals

Be able to discuss previous grant work and their specific role in successful outcomes

Have excellent written English and strong editing skills

Understand how to align proposals with funder priorities

Be able to improve an existing draft without losing the organization's voice

Be highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented

Work independently and communicate clearly

Be comfortable providing thoughtful, constructive feedback

Experience with youth-serving nonprofits, education, youth development, foundation grants, corporate giving, or government funding is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means helping us find stronger funding opportunities, improve the quality of our proposals, stay organized, and submit polished applications on time.

We are not looking for someone to simply provide generic grant lists or complete administrative tasks. We want a collaborative professional who can bring experience and judgment to the work we are already doing.



Schedule & Compensation

This is a remote, part-time position of up to 10 hours per week with flexible scheduling. Compensation is 5–8 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

title: Accountant – Accounts Receivable & Manufacturing
description:
ACCOUNTANT – ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & MANUFACTURING



Australian Manufacturing Group | Full Time | Remote – Philippines



Salary: PHP 80,000 – PHP 110,000 per month, depending on experience



ABOUT US



We are a growing Australian manufacturing and distribution group operating across multiple locations.



We are strengthening our finance team and looking for an experienced accountant who combines strong accounting skills with confidence dealing directly with customers.



This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on accounts receivable, customer collections, month-end accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and manufacturing/inventory accounting.



You will work closely with our CFO and Australian management team and have genuine ownership of your work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



A major focus of this role will be taking ownership of our customer accounts and overdue debtors.



We need someone who is genuinely comfortable picking up the phone and speaking directly with customers – not just sending reminder
s.



You will follow up overdue accounts, understand why invoices haven't been paid, resolve disputes and documentation issues, work with our internal sales and operations teams, agree next steps with customers and follow issues through until they are resolved.



This is not purely a collections role.



You will also work across the broader finance function, including month-end, balance sheet reconciliations and inventory/manufacturing accounting.



Because we are a manufacturing business, previous experience working in manufacturing, distribution or another inventory-based business is important. You should have a practical understanding of how inventory flows through a business and impacts the financial accounts.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is confident, curious and proactive.



If something doesn't reconcile or doesn't make sense, we want you to investigate why – not simply report that there is a problem.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Take ownership of overdue customer accounts and collections



• Proactively call and
 customers regarding outstanding invoices



• Build strong working relationships with customers



• Investigate disputed invoices, missing purchase orders, credits, delivery issues and other reasons for non-payment



• Work with customers, sales, operations and finance to resolve issues and get accounts paid



• Agree and actively follow up customer payment commitments



• Maintain clear collection notes and follow-up actions



• Allocate and reconcile customer receipts



• Reconcile accounts receivable to the general ledger



• Investigate unapplied receipts, credits and customer account discrepancies



• Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and investigate variances



• Assist with month-end journals, accruals and prepayments



• Investigate unusual or unexplained general ledger balances



• Assist with inventory and stock reconciliations



• Investigate inventory movements, adjustments and discrepancies



• Assist with inventory-to-general-ledger reconciliations



• Understand the accounting flow from purchasing and raw materials through production, finished goods and cost of goods sold



• Support monthly management reporting and cash flow reporting



• Work with the broader team to improve finance processes and controls



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Accounting degree or equivalent qualification



• At least 4 years of relevant accounting experience



• Previous experience in a manufacturing, distribution or inventory-based business



• Practical experience with inventory accounting and reconciliations



• Strong accounts receivable and customer account reconciliation experience



• Experience preparing balance sheet reconciliations and supporting month-end close



• Good understanding of general ledger accounting



• Confidence speaking directly with customers by phone



• Excellent spoken and written English



• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills



• Experience using an ERP or accounting system



• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail



• Able to work independently, ask questions and take ownership of issues



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



• Manufacturing accounting experience



• Experience with BOMs, WIP, inventory movements or product costing



• Odoo ERP experience



• Experience with SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics or another ERP



• Experience working with Australian businesses



• Knowledge of Australian GST/BAS



• CPA, CA or equivalent qualification



ABOUT YOU



We're not looking for someone who just works through a task list.



If a customer hasn't paid, you're comfortable picking up the phone, finding out why and working with them to resolve it.



If an account doesn't reconcile, you want to understand what's causing the difference.



If something doesn't make sense, you ask questions.



You enjoy solving problems and following them through to resolution.



You'll work closely with our CFO and people across finance, sales and operations, so we're looking for someone who communicates well, builds relationships and takes genuine ownership of their work.



WHAT WE OFFER



• Long-term, stable full-time opportunity



• Direct exposure to the CFO and Australian management team



• Genuine responsibility and ownership



• Exposure to a multi-location Australian manufacturing business



• Opportunity to develop your manufacturing and management accounting experience



• Opportunity to contribute ideas and improve systems and processes



• Supportive team environment with room to grow



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your CV



2. Your expected monthly salary in PHP



3. Your notice period or earliest available start date



4. A short 60–90 second video introduction telling us:



* A little about yourself

* Your accounting and manufacturing/inventory experience

* Your experience speaking with customers and handling collections



Please also answer the following questions:



1. MANUFACTURING & INVENTORY



What manufacturing, distribution or inventory-based businesses have you worked in?



Briefly describe the inventory accounting you have been responsible for, including any experience with stock reconciliations, WIP, costing or inventory-to-GL reconciliations.



2. CUSTOMER COLLECTIONS



A customer owes AUD $85,000 across several overdue invoices.



When you speak with them, they tell you one invoice cannot be paid because it is missing a purchase order and another relates to goods they say have not been delivered.



What would you do next?



3. BALANCE SHEET RECONCILIATION



You are preparing a month-end reconciliation.



The general ledger shows a balance of $250,000 but the supporting schedule totals $190,000.



How would you investigate the $60,000 difference before making any adjustment?



4. COMMUNICATION



This role involves regular phone calls with Australian customers.



Tell us about your experience handling collection calls, discussing overdue accounts and resolving customer issues over the phone.



Please answer all four questions with your application.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Specialist – Help Us Scale 40+ Clients
description:
# Senior SEO & GEO Specialist



**Remote | Philippines | 10–15 hours/week | $15–25/hour | Long-term opportunity**



We are looking for an experienced **Senior SEO & GEO Specialist** to become the technical and strategic SEO expert behind our growing client portfolio.



We currently manage SEO for approximately **35–40 Danish businesses** and want to significantly grow our SEO MRR while maintaining — and improving — the quality of our work and client retention.



This is **not a junior SEO role**.



We are willing to pay up to **$25/hour for someone who is genuinely excellent**.



We prefer 15 hours from an outstanding SEO specialist over 40 hours from an average one.



## About the Role



Your primary responsibility will be the **actual SEO and GEO work behind our client portfolio**.



You will not primarily be responsible for customer communication.



We already have a team member who manages customer communication, coordination and follow-up.



Your job is to be the **SEO expert behind the work**.



You will:



**Analyze ? Prioritize ? Execute ? Measure ? Document ? Recommend what happens next.**



We don't want someone who simply runs an Ahrefs or Semrush audit and sends us a list of 100 errors.



We want someone who can look at a website and determine:



**"What are the most important things we can do to improve this client's organic performance?"**



## SEO Strategy & Execution



You should have strong experience with:



* SEO strategy

* Keyword research

* Search intent

* SERP analysis

* Competitor analysis

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools

* On-page SEO

* Content optimization

* Content briefs

* Landing page strategy

* Internal linking

* Site architecture

* Keyword cannibalization

* Indexation

* Crawlability

* Canonicals

* Redirects

* XML sitemaps

* Robots.txt

* Schema / structured data

* Duplicate content

* Broken links

* Diagnosing ranking and traffic declines



Most importantly, you need to know how to **prioritize**.



Finding an SEO problem does not automatically mean it is worth spending time fixing.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



**"This is technically imperfect."**



and:



**"Fixing this is likely to have a meaningful impact."**



## Technical SEO & Website Performance



You will NOT be responsible for building websites.



However, you must be comfortable working hands-on with **existing websites and improving their technical and SEO performance**.



Website performance is an important part of this role.



You should be comfortable investigating and improving:



* Core Web Vitals

* Google PageSpeed Insights

* Lighthouse

* LCP

* INP

* CLS

* Website loading speed

* Mobile performance

* Image optimization

* Image compression

* WebP / AVIF

* Lazy loading

* Caching

* CDN configuration

* WordPress performance

* Plugin performance

* Fonts

* CSS and JavaScript optimization

* Render-blocking resources

* Third-party scripts

* Server response issues

* JavaScript-related SEO issues



We don't want someone who simply tells us:



**"The website is slow."**



We want someone who investigates **why** it is slow and improves the things that can reasonably be improved on the existing website.



For example, if a WordPress website has poor Core Web Vitals because of oversized images, unnecessary plugins, caching configuration or render-blocking resources, you should be comfortable investigating and improving these issues.



You are NOT expected to be a full-stack developer.



If something genuinely requires development work, you should be able to clearly document:



**What is wrong ? Why it matters ? What needs to change ? How we verify the fix afterwards.**



You should then verify that the developer's solution actually fixed the problem.



The goal is:



**Make our clients' existing websites perform better — technically, in search engines and for users.**



## GEO / AI Search



We want GEO / AI Search to become a natural part of our SEO offering.



You should therefore be actively interested in and working with:



* GEO / Generative Engine Optimization

* AI Search

* AI Overviews

* LLM visibility

* Entity and brand signals

* Brand mentions and citations

* Structured data

* Topical authority

* Content structure for AI discovery

* Clear question/answer content

* Original and first-party information

* Authority and trust signals

* How traditional SEO influences AI visibility

* Measuring and monitoring AI visibility where reasonably possible



We do NOT expect you to claim that you have completely "solved GEO."



This area is developing quickly.



We prefer someone who tests, learns and thinks critically.



We want you to understand:



**What appears to actually work — and what is just GEO hype.**



## Link Building & Authority



We also want to develop our authority/link-building offering.



You should understand:



* Backlink analysis

* Competitor backlink analysis

* Link gaps

* Relevance

* Authority

* Anchor text

* Toxic/spammy links

* Link quality

* Authority gaps



You should be able to identify when link building could genuinely help a client.



But you should also be comfortable saying:



**"Links are not the priority for this client right now."**



We are not interested in hundreds of cheap, low-quality backlinks.



Quality, relevance and business impact matter.



## Client Retention



We currently manage approximately **35–40 SEO clients** and intend to grow.



Keeping our existing clients is just as important as acquiring new ones.



Part of your responsibility will therefore be helping us identify clients that require attention before they become dissatisfied.



We want to gradually classify accounts based on things such as:



**Healthy**

Performance and work are developing as expected.



**Attention**

Performance is stagnating or there are issues/opportunities requiring attention.



**Risk**

There is a significant decline, technical problem or other concern.



**Opportunity**

There is a clear opportunity for additional organic growth.



We want to become increasingly proactive.



If a client's organic traffic suddenly starts declining, we want to know and investigate **before the client asks us why**.



## Identify Growth Opportunities



We also want you to identify opportunities that can create additional value for our clients.



This could include:



* Link building

* Authority improvements

* Additional landing pages

* Content opportunities

* GEO opportunities

* Technical improvements

* Competitor gaps

* Content gaps

* New keyword opportunities



You will not primarily be responsible for selling these services.



Your responsibility is to identify and explain the **business and SEO opportunity**.



Our customer-facing team can then discuss it with the client.



## Documentation Is Essential



This is extremely important.



Our customer coordinator needs to understand what has been done so that the work can be communicated clearly to the client.



After working on a client, you should document:



### WHAT DID YOU FIND?



What did your analysis show?



### WHAT DID YOU DO?



What did you actually change or implement?



### WHY?



Why was this work prioritized?



### RESULT / MONITORING



What happened, or what should we monitor going forward?



### NEXT ACTION



What should happen next?



We never want a situation where someone asks:



**"What did we actually do for this client this month?"**



and nobody can answer clearly.



## Working With Our Customer Coordinator



You will work alongside an existing team member who is responsible for customer communication and coordination.



The ideal workflow is:



**You identify and execute the SEO/GEO work**



?



**You document what was done and why**



?



**Our coordinator communicates clearly with the client**



?



**You continue monitoring performance and determining the next priorities**



This allows you to spend the majority of your time on SEO rather than customer service.



## Help Us Build a Scalable SEO Operation



We are not only hiring you to complete tasks.



We also want your expertise to help us improve **how we deliver SEO across the entire portfolio**.



Over time, we want your input on:



* What should happen when a new SEO client starts?

* What should we check every month?

* What should we check quarterly?

* How should we monitor 40+ clients efficiently?

* How do we identify clients at risk?

* How should we prioritize work?

* How should SEO work be documented?

* How should GEO be incorporated into our product?

* How should we identify growth opportunities?

* What should be standardized?

* What can be automated?

* What requires senior expertise?

* What can be delegated to other team members?



We want to build a system that can support significantly more clients **without sacrificing quality**.



## Danish Websites



Our clients are primarily Danish businesses.



The websites, keywords, Search Console queries, content and other information you work with will therefore often be in **Danish**.



You do NOT need to speak Danish.



Our internal communication with you will be in **English**.



You should be comfortable using tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools** to translate and understand Danish content independently.



However, simply translating a keyword from English to Danish is not SEO research.



You still need to use:



* SERP analysis

* Search Console

* Keyword data

* Competitors

* Search intent

* Actual search behavior



to determine what Danish users are searching for.



Language should not prevent you from doing excellent SEO.



## AI Is Part of the Workflow



You should be highly comfortable using modern AI tools.



We encourage the intelligent use of AI for:



* Research

* Translation

* Data analysis

* Content analysis

* Content briefs

* Identifying patterns

* Documentation

* SOP creation

* Workflow improvements

* Brainstorming

* Scaling repetitive parts of SEO



But we are NOT looking for someone who generates generic AI content and calls it SEO.



**AI should make your SEO expertise more productive — not replace your SEO expertise.**



## Who We Are Looking For



You are:



* A genuinely experienced SEO specialist

* Strong in technical SEO

* Strong in on-page SEO

* Strong with Google Search Console

* Comfortable improving existing website performance

* Analytical

* Commercially aware

* Excellent at prioritizing

* Comfortable working hands-on

* Curious about GEO and AI Search

* Knowledgeable about authority and link building

* Comfortable challenging assumptions

* Proactive

* Good at documenting your work

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to explain complex SEO issues simply

* Interested in improving systems and processes



Most importantly:



**You think like an SEO specialist, not an SEO checklist.**



## Hours & Compensation



We are initially looking for:



**10–15 hours per week**



Compensation:



**$15–25 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.**



We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who is genuinely excellent.



We prefer:



**15 hours from an excellent specialist**



over



**40 hours from an average specialist.**



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As our SEO portfolio grows, there may be opportunities for additional hours and responsibility.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**"SEO is about priorities."**



Applications that do not start with these words will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. How many years you have worked professionally with SEO.

4. Your strongest SEO skills.

5. Your experience with technical SEO.

6. Examples of website performance/Core Web Vitals improvements you have personally implemented.

7. Your experience with Google Search Console.

8. Your experience with Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools.

9. Your experience with link building and authority.

10. Your experience with GEO / AI Search.

11. How you currently use AI in your SEO work.

12. Your expected hourly rate.

13. Your weekly availability.



## Please Answer These Questions



**1. A website loses 30% of its organic clicks over three months. What are the first things you investigate, and why?**



**2. A client's website has poor Core Web Vitals. PageSpeed shows multiple problems. Walk us through how you d
 what actually needs to be fixed and what you would personally implement.**



**3. You only have two hours available for a client this month. How do you d
 what to work on?**



**4. A competitor has significantly more backlinks than our client. Does that automatically mean we should build links? Explain your thinking.**



**5. What do you currently believe is genuinely important for GEO / AI Search visibility — and what do you think is mostly hype?**



**6. Tell us about an SEO recommendation you deliberately chose NOT to implement because something else was more important.**



## Paid Practical Test



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical SEO test**.



You will receive a real website and realistic data.



We will ask you to analyze the situation and tell us:



* What you found

* What concerns you

* What opportunities you see

* What you would prioritize

* What you would NOT spend time on

* What you would personally implement

* What requires a developer

* What you would do over the next 90 days

* Why



We are NOT interested in who can produce the longest SEO audit.



We are interested in who can identify:



**What actually matters.**



If you are an experienced SEO specialist who enjoys solving difficult problems, improving websites, working with data and helping build a scalable SEO operation, we would like to hear from you.

title: Remote Social Media Outreach VA
description:
Remote Social Media Outreach VA

Commission-Based | Entry Level | Growth Opportunity



Bloom Photography is looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to help with social media outreach and relationship building.



This is a remote, commission-only position to start with a very manageable daily workload. We are looking for someone who communicates well in English, is organized, comfortable using social media, and can consistently follow a simple outreach process.



STARTING RESPONSIBILITIES



Your initial responsibilities will include:



* Send approximately 10 Instagram DMs per day to prospective clients using a script we provide

* Review and engage with each prospect's profile before reaching out

* Like relevant posts and content

* Leave appropriate comments using examples and scripts we provide

* Share or otherwise engage with content when appropriate

* Keep an organized record of every person contacted

* Track who responds and who does not

* Follow up with prospects who have not responded within approximately 2 weeks

* Notify us when a prospect responds so we can take over the conversation



You will not be responsible for closing sales.



Your primary job is to identify the right prospects, create an authentic first point of contact, send the initial message, and make sure nobody falls through the cracks.



COMPENSATION



This position is commission-only during the initial stage.



You will be paid $30 for every NEW CLIENT booked as a result of your outreach efforts.



There is no limit to the number of commissions you can earn.



INITIAL WORKLOAD



We want to start simple.



During your first 30 days, your primary responsibility will be one social media account and approximately 10 new outreach messages per day, along with engagement, tracking, and follow-up.



We care much more about consistency, organization, and quality than sending hundreds of messages.



After a successful 30-day trial period, we may begin adding additional accounts and responsibilities.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Be conversational and comfortable communicating in English

* Have strong enough written English to interact naturally on social media

* Be familiar with Instagram,
, and X/Twitter

* Be comfortable working independently

* Be highly organized

* Be able to keep accurate records without constant supervision

* Be dependable about following up with contacts

* Be comfortable following scripts and established processes

* Have reliable internet access

* Be interested in growing into a larger role over time



Previous VA, customer service, social media, or sales experience is helpful, but not required.



Reliability, attention to detail, communication, and willingness to learn are more important to us.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are specifically looking for someone who could grow with the company.



For the right person, this role may eventually develop into a part-time hourly position and potentially a full-time hourly position.



Future responsibilities could include:



* Managing additional social media accounts

* Appointment booking and scheduling

* Responding to basic inquiries

*
 management

* CRM and contact management

* Client follow-up

* Administrative work

* Other online business support tasks



We would prefer to find someone we can train and develop over time rather than continually hiring for individual tasks.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. Your name and location/time zone

2. A brief introduction about yourself

3. Your experience with Instagram,
, and X/Twitter

4. Any previous VA, customer service, social media, or sales experience

title: Social Media Manager
description:

This is a full account management role. That means you are not just posting content and calling it a day. You are thinking about the accounts you handle, making decisions on content, and taking responsibility for how they grow.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run assigned accounts day to day

title: Creative Designer & Brand Marketing Executive
description:
Graphic Design, Social Media, Influencers & Product Launches



Full-time remote role | Philippines

Salary: PHP 35,000–40,000 per month, depending on experience and portfolio



About Baie Botanique



Baie Botanique is an award-winning British premium vegan skincare and mineral sun-care brand. Our products are sold internationally through our Shopify websites, Amazon marketplaces and a growing network of retailers and distributors.



We are looking for a creative, highly organised and proactive Creative Brand Marketing Executive to join our remote team.



This is not simply a social-media posting role.



You will help us plan and deliver product launches, create premium marketing materials, coordinate influencers and brand collaborations, manage our content calendar and strengthen our presence across social-media channels, including Pinterest.



Strong hands-on graphic-design skills are essential. You must be able to personally create polished, premium-looking materials for consumers, retailers and advertising campaigns, with excellent attention to typography, composition, image selection, product presentation and detail.



Key Responsibilities

- Graphic Design and Creative Assets

- Design premium brochures, presentations and sales materials for retailers and distributors.

- Create high-quality graphics for Meta and other digital advertising campaigns.

- Produce social-media graphics, carousels, promotional assets and launch materials.

- Create and update Amazon listing graphics and product imagery.

- Edit and retouch product photography and create realistic product composites where required, with careful attention to lighting, shadows, scale, perspective and overall realism.

- Design website banners,
 graphics and other digital assets.

- Create mobile-first creative with clear visual hierarchy, legible messaging and strong calls to action, balancing premium aesthetics with commercial effectiveness.

- Resize and adapt creative materials for different platforms.

- Maintain a consistent, premium brand identity across all marketing materials.

- Prepare professional layouts suitable for digital distribution and, where required, printing.



Marketing Calendar and Product Launches

- Help develop, plan and maintain the marketing and content calendar.

- Work with the Founder to turn business priorities into detailed marketing campaigns.

- Contribute ideas for product launches, seasonal campaigns, promotions and brand-building activity.

- Coordinate the assets, content and deadlines required for each product launch.

- Ensure campaigns are delivered across social media, Shopify, Amazon,
 marketing, influencers and retail channels.

- Monitor progress and follow up with relevant team members to keep projects on schedule.



Social Media and Content

- Help shape the content strategy for the brand rather than simply waiting for posts to be assigned.

- Plan, create, schedule and publish content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Pinterest and other relevant channels.

- Identify opportunities to grow Baie Botanique through Pinterest.

- Repurpose existing content into different formats for different platforms.

- Research beauty, skincare, sun-care and social-media trends.

- Review performance and recommend improvements to content and campaigns.

- Use AI tools to support caption writing, content ideas, research, planning and repurposing.



Influencers and Brand Collaborations

- Manage influencer activity through our influencer platform.

- Review and select influencers who are a strong fit for the brand.

- Send campaign briefs and contracts.

- Communicate clearly with influencers and answer campaign questions.

- Track agreed deadlines and deliverables.

- Review submitted content and provide feedback or direction where needed.

- Follow up to ensure content is produced and published as agreed.

- Identify suitable brands for online collaborations, partnerships and giveaways.

- Coordinate collaboration timelines and ensure both brands complete the agreed activity.



AI and Improved Ways of Working

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI and other suitable platforms to improve quality and efficiency.

- Use AI to assist with content planning, captions, campaign concepts, research and repurposing.

- Review and improve AI-generated work rather than publishing generic or unedited content.

- Stay curious about emerging tools and suggest better ways of completing marketing tasks.



Essential Requirements

- Strong professional graphic-design skills and an excellent visual portfolio.

- Advanced Canva skills together with strong Adobe Photoshop and/or Illustrator skills, or equivalent professional design software.

- Strong image-editing and product-compositing skills, including an understanding of realistic lighting, shadows, scale, perspective and retouching.

- An excellent eye for premium branding, typography, composition, spacing, visual hierarchy and detail.

- Ability to create designs that are not only visually strong but also mobile-friendly and commercially effective.

- Experience creating brochures, presentations, advertisements or other professional marketing assets.

- Social-media planning, creation and publishing experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational and project-management skills.

- Ability to manage several campaigns and deadlines at the same time.

- Experience using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools.

- Proactive and confident in contributing ideas.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote team.

- Reliable, responsive and able to take ownership of tasks.



Desirable Experience

- Meta advertising graphics.

- Pinterest strategy and content creation.

- Influencer or creator campaign management.

- Brand collaborations and online giveaways.

- Shopify.

- Amazon listing images or A+ Content.

- CapCut or other short-form video-editing tools.

- Beauty, skincare, wellness, fashion or premium lifestyle brands.

- Product-launch and e-commerce marketing.



The Type of Person We Are Looking For



You may be a strong graphic designer who has moved into marketing, or a creative marketer with particularly strong design skills.



You should enjoy both the creative and organisational sides of marketing. One day you may be designing a retailer brochure; another day you may be planning a product-launch calendar, selecting influencers or coordinating a brand collaboration.



We do not want someone who waits to be told exactly what to do at every stage. We are looking for someone who will research, propose ideas, prepare plans and then execute agreed activity to a high standard.



The Founder will continue to set the overall business priorities and approve key strategic decisions. You will help develop the detailed marketing plans and bring those priorities to life.



Working Arrangements

- Full-time remote position.

- 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday.

- You must be available for agreed crossover hours with the UK team.

- Long-term position for the right person.

- Starting salary of PHP 35,000–40,000 per month, depending on relevant experience, skills and portfolio.

- Performance and salary review following successful completion of the initial review period.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



- CV/resume.

- Portfolio link — with a note asking them to highlight 2–3 pieces they feel are most relevant to Baie Botanique.

- Brief summary of their social media/marketing experience, including influencers or launches if applicable.

- Current employment status + earliest start date.

- Expected monthly salary.

- Start the application with “Creative Brand Marketing.”





Applications without a portfolio or relevant design examples will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical paid assessment involving graphic design, campaign planning and marketing coordination.

title: Marketing & Operations Coordinator
description:
Marketing & Operations Coordinator — Virtual Real Estate Team



Please complete our application here:






**Please do not send a résumé through OnlineJobs.ph.** We are only reviewing candidates who complete the Google Form above.



### About the role



We are looking for a smart, dependable, highly organized virtual assistant who can become a trusted long-term member of our residential real estate team.



This role combines **marketing ownership, project coordination, and flexible behind-the-scenes support.**



**Marketing will be your primary area of responsibility.**



We do not want someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every day. We are looking for someone who can learn our business, understand our brand, notice what needs attention, bring us ideas, and then help carry those ideas through to completion.



You will help keep our social media, monthly newsletter, monthly mailer, listing marketing, client events, and other recurring marketing projects moving from **idea to finished product.**



We are also a small team in a fast-moving business. At times, you may help our Director of Operations with clearly delegated administrative, listing, or transaction-related tasks. You should be comfortable switching gears and pitching in where needed.



### What you might work on in a typical month



* Build and maintain our marketing calendar

* Develop ideas for social media content

* Create social media graphics and captions

* Create or coordinate reels and other short-form video

* Assemble our monthly
 newsletter

* Design our monthly physical mailer

* Create listing flyers and other marketing materials

* Repurpose existing content into new formats

* Organize marketing photos, videos, templates, and brand assets

* Maintain project trackers and follow up on open items

* Update our CRM

* Prepare forms or documents for review

* Update internal checklists and records

* Organize listing or transaction files

* Help schedule routine services, vendors, signs, or materials

* Follow up when approvals, information, or decisions are needed



### The person we are looking for



You are organized, but adaptable.



You care about details, but you do not get paralyzed by perfection.



You can take direction, but you also know how to move something forward without having every step spelled out.



You are comfortable saying, **“I noticed this. Here’s what I think we should do.”**



You communicate when you are stuck rather than quietly letting something sit.



You can learn someone’s writing style instead of producing generic, AI-sounding content.



You understand when to handle something independently and when to bring it to a team leader.



You are willing to do both creative work and less glamorous administrative work.



Most importantly, **you follow through.**



### Helpful experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Real estate administration or transaction coordination

* Canva

* Social media content creation

* Reels or short-form video editing

*
 marketing

* CRM platforms

* Google Drive and cloud file organization

* Project-management software

* Matrix MLS

* TransactionDesk



You do **not** need to check every box.



Strong communication skills, judgment, organization, attention to detail, creativity, and a willingness to learn are more important than already knowing every program we use.



### Schedule



This is a **part-time role**.



We are looking for someone who can consistently work approximately **15–20 hours per week**, Monday through Friday.



Because you will work closely with our Director of Operations, we need approximately **four hours of consistent live overlap during our normal Pacific-time workday**, generally somewhere between **9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Pacific Time.**



The exact daily schedule can be discussed, but reliable overlap and availability during those hours are important.



### Our values



* Put Clients First

* Own What We Can Control

* Pursue Excellence

* Protect the Team

* Bring Energy and Be Yourself



We are looking for someone who wants more than a collection of freelance tasks.



We want someone who enjoys becoming an important part of a team, taking ownership of their work, and helping improve how the business operates over time.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
## Role



We’re hiring a Social Media Manager to own the strategy, coordination, and execution of social media distribution for some of the fastest-growing podcast brands on the internet. 



You will manage end-to-end social media execution across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, X, and LinkedIn, turning podcast episodes into high-performing content that drives millions of views.



You’ll work directly with high-profile entrepreneurs and founders who are building movements, not just audiences. You’ll collaborate closely with a world-class creative team and take real ownership of growth outcomes across multiple high-stakes brands. 



This role is ideal for someone who has worked in an agency before, deeply understands social media, uses AI to optimise their workflow, and can assist with contnet ideas for clients.



## What You Own



You own the distribution, positioning, and performance of content once it is ready to publish. That means d
 what gets posted, how it is positioned, when it goes live, how it performs, and what to optimise next. You are accountable for outcomes, not production.



## Role Clarity (Important)



This is not an editing or graphic design role. You will not be editing videos or designing thumbnails. Your responsibility is to ensure content is ready to publish. This means being able to quickly spot spelling or factual errors, incorrect branding or tone, and visuals, thumbnails, or covers that are clearly off-standard. 



## Responsibilities

Captioning & Hooks (AI-Assisted): Write click-worthy captions, hooks, and titles using AI and strategic thinking

Content Readiness Checks: Before publishing, confirm content is accurate, on-brand, and free from obvious errors.

Publishing & Scheduling: Upload, schedule, and publish content across YouTube, TikTok, Meta (FB & IG), X, and LinkedIn with zero mistakes.

Creative Awareness: Ensure YouTube thumbnails, IG covers, and episode graphics meet brand standards and are suitable for publishing.

Client Communication: Manage daily communication, approvals, and feedback with clients clearly and professionally.

Content & Trend Research: Track viral trends, analyse competitors, and pitch fresh content ideas weekly.

Performance Tracking: Monitor performance using Metricool and reporting tools to identify wins and optimisation opportunities.

Systems & Ops Support: Maintain clean 
 structures, update weekly distribution schedules, and keep workflows organised.



## Requirements

Must be able to manage 5-10 clients, ideally suited for someone with agency experience

2+ years managing social media professionally with proven growth results.

Strong understanding of short-form and long-form content performance.

Strategic awareness of editing and design principles (hooks, pacing, thumbnails) without doing the work.

Experience with or familiarity in YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, X, LinkedIn, Canva (review and light adjustments only), ChatGPT or similar AI tools, Metricool or similar scheduling platforms.

Highly desired: 
, 
, podcast hosting platforms, transcription tools.

Data-driven mindset with attention to detail.

Native-level written English.

Reliable internet connection.

Available 8AM–5PM AEST.



## Compensation



Base Rate: $8–$12 AUD per hour, based on experience and results.



Performance Bonuses

Monthly Views Bonus

Viral Content Bonus

Quarterly Performance Bonus

Quarterly Innovation Bonus

World-Class Training: Access to elite marketing education and weekly growth sessions.



## Working With Us



We move fast, hold high standards, and expect ownership. This is not a passive role. You are trusted to think, d
, and execute. If you want comfort and predictability, this isn’t it. If you want growth, responsibility, and real impact, you’ll thrive here.



## How to Apply



Resume including links to accounts you’ve grown and clear metrics.



Send a 60-second video pitch covering why your right for the role. This MUST be custom tailored to our business. Your video pitch replaces a cover letter.
