title: Webflow Website & Video Editor | Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are a New Zealand-based professional services business looking for a reliable and capable person in the Philippines to join our small team in a long-term, part-time role of approximately 20 hours per week.



The ideal person is strong with websites, comfortable editing videos, and interested in building a stable long-term working relationship.



Your main ongoing responsibility will be helping us migrate our current Weebly website to Webflow and then maintain and improve it.



We already have a team member in the Philippines who has worked with us for more than four years. We value good people and long-term working relationships and are looking for someone who would also like to grow with us over time.



This is not a general administrative VA role.



Main Responsibility: Weebly to Webflow Migration

Our existing website is currently built on Weebly.

We are progressively migrating the website and its existing content to Webflow while improving its design, structure and presentation.



Your website work will include:

• Migrating existing pages and content from Weebly to Webflow

• Creating and formatting Webflow pages

• Improving page layouts and presentation

• Updating existing website content

• Publishing and formatting blog articles

• Adding images, internal links and other website content

• Checking pages across desktop and mobile

• Implementing basic on-page SEO

• Making ongoing website improvements



If there is no urgent video or content work, continuing the website migration will be your regular ongoing task.

Previous Webflow experience is preferred, but it is not essential.



If you already have good website development or CMS experience and are confident you can learn Webflow quickly, we would still like to hear from you.



Video and Digital Content

We also regularly produce professional and educational content.

We will provide the ideas, specialist information, written material and raw video recordings.

Your role will be to turn this material into finished digital content, including:

• Editing YouTube videos

• Creating YouTube Shorts and other short-form videos

• Creating attractive YouTube thumbnails

• Creating simple graphics

• Preparing videos for publication

• Repurposing videos and articles for social media

• Publishing and scheduling approved content

You will not be expected to do all of these tasks at the same time.



Website migration will be your regular ongoing work. Video and digital content tasks will take priority when new material becomes available.



You are also not expected to be equally strong in every area. Website capability is our most important requirement, followed by video editing.



You will not be expected to develop our overall marketing strategy or create specialist professional content from scratch. We will provide the subject matter and direction.



What We Are Looking For

The most important things for us are:

1. Good website and technical ability

2. Good video editing skills

3. Good visual and design judgement

4. Basic SEO and website publishing knowledge

5. Familiarity with social media content

6. Reliability and attention to detail

7. Ability to work independently

8. Ability to learn new tools quickly

9. Good written English and communication

We do not expect you to be an expert in everything.



If you are particularly strong in website work and reasonably good at video editing and design, we would be very interested in hearing from you.



AI

You do not need to be an AI expert.

Basic familiarity with Gemini, ChatGPT or similar AI tools is sufficient. We already have our own prompts and workflows that we can share with you.



We are much more interested in your practical website, video and creative abilities.



How We Work

You will work directly with the business owner in New Zealand and receive your priorities and instructions directly from him.

We will provide clear guidance and systems when you start. As you become familiar with the role, we would like you to become increasingly independent and take ownership of your work.



We appreciate people who can identify problems, solve them and suggest improvements when they see a better way of doing something.



The work can generally be completed flexibly, although reliable communication and reasonable availability during agreed times will be important.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship rather than someone interested only in completing the website migration and moving on.



For the right person, there may be opportunities for increased hours, responsibility and compensation over time.

Compensation will depend on your skills, experience and agreed working arrangement. Please tell us your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in PHP when applying.



How to Apply

To show that you have read the full job post, please start your application with the words:

WEB + VIDEO



Then provide:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your current work or study situation

2. Your availability and how many hours per week you can work

3. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in PHP

4. Links to websites or webpages you have personally built, designed or maintained

5. Links to videos you have personally edited

6. Examples of thumbnails or graphics you have created, if available

7. Your experience with Webflow and whether you have previously migrated a website from one platform to another

8. Which is your strongest area: website work, video editing or graphic design



Please keep your application clear and concise.



We are much more interested in seeing examples of your actual work than receiving a long generic cover letter.

If you are technically capable, creative, reliable and looking for a stable long-term role with a New Zealand business, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

title: Video Editor / AI Creative Editor — Jewelry E-Commerce
description:
About Us:



LovEmbrace is a personalised jewelry brand selling engraved necklaces, rings, and bracelets to customers in the UK and US. Our products are emotional, they carry names, birthstones, initials, and dates that mean something to the people wearing them. Our advertising has to carry that same emotional weight while still stopping the scroll.



We advertise primarily on Meta and TikTok, and creative is the single biggest lever on our performance. We test constantly, we move fast, and we're looking for someone who wants to own that process rather than just execute tickets.





The Role:

You'll be our dedicated video editor, producing paid social ad creative on a weekly cycle. Most of your output will support new and upcoming product launches, meaning you'll often be creating compelling video for products with little or no existing footage. That's where AI video generation becomes essential, and it's the part of this role we care most about.



This is a production role with creative input. You won't be handed finished storyboards. You'll be given a product, a hook angle, and a brand direction, and you'll be expected to turn that into something we can put money behind.





What You'll Do:

- Produce finished video ads for Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories) and TikTok, cut to the correct aspect ratios and platform specs

- Generate AI video content for products where we have limited or no live footage. This includes model shots, lifestyle scenes, gifting moments, and B-roll

- Create multiple variations of winning concepts (new hooks, new opening frames, new pacing, new CTAs) so we can isolate what's actually driving performance

- Edit and repurpose UGC, influencer footage, and product photography into ad-ready assets

- Add captions, sound design, licensed music, motion graphics, and on-screen text that match our brand style

- Maintain an organised asset library so past clips, hooks, and endings can be reused quickly

- Adapt creative based on performance feedback. We'll share what's working and what isn't, and you'll iterate on it





Weekly Output Expectations:

- 35-40 hours per week

- Creating several new ad concepts per week, built around distinct hooks or angles

- Creating variations and iterations of existing concepts for iterative testing

- Turnaround on a single requested edit or revision within 72 hours



Volume matters here, but so does quality. A batch of rushed, near-identical cuts is worse than fewer ads that are genuinely different from each other.





Requirements:

- 1+ year of video editing experience, with a portfolio of paid social ads (not wedding videos, not YouTube vlogs. Direct response ad creative)

- Strong hands-on experience with AI video tools. Tell us which ones you use and what you've built with them. We work with tools in the Veo / Sora / Kling / Runway / Higgsfield / HeyGen space, plus AI image generation for stills and scene building

- Fluent in a professional editing suite. Premiere Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

- A real understanding of what makes a paid social ad work: the first 3 seconds, pattern interrupts, pacing, retention, and clear CTAs

- Ability to produce believable, high-quality AI output.  No uncanny hands, warped jewelry, melting text, or obvious artefacts. You know how to iterate on prompts until the result is clean, and you know when to abandon an AI shot and solve it another way

- Excellent written English and reliable, proactive communication

- Reliable high-speed internet and a machine capable of handling video work without constant crashes





Nice to Have:



- Previous experience in jewelry, fashion, beauty, or another visual/gifting-led category

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, and comfort reading basic creative performance metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC and CPM)

- Experience with creative research and swipe file tools such as Foreplay

- Basic graphic design ability for static ads and thumbnails

- Understanding of music licensing and commercial usage rights for paid ads





What We Offer:

Full-time, long-term remote position with a growing brand

Direct working relationship with the founder. No layers of management, fast decisions

Genuine creative ownership: your ads get real budget behind them, and you'll see exactly how they perform

Room to grow with the business as we scale spend





How to Apply:



Please send the following:



Your portfolio or showreel, with paid social ad work clearly identified

At least one example of AI-generated video you personally created, along with a short note on which tools you used and how you approached it

A few sentences on your favourite ad you've ever seen (any brand) and why you think it worked

Your availability and earliest start date





Screening task: 

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to produce one 15–20 second ad for one of our products using assets we provide plus AI-generated footage. This is how we assess real capability, and it's the most important part of the process.



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

description:

This is not simply an execution role. We need someone who can think strategically, communicate confidently with clients, coordinate with a marketing team, and take ownership of the overall marketing direction.



Key Responsibilities

Develop comprehensive marketing strategies based on each client's goals, target audience, industry, and current performance.

Create integrated strategies across SEO, websites, content, social media,
 marketing/newsletters, paid advertising, branding, and lead generation.

Review existing client marketing efforts and identify gaps, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Develop clear marketing priorities, campaign recommendations, timelines, and action plans.

Participate in client meetings and confidently explain strategies, recommendations, and next steps.

Coordinate with SEO specialists, paid ads specialists, designers, developers, copywriters, and other team members to execute strategies.

Ensure marketing deliverables remain aligned with client objectives and brand standards.

Review marketing data and campaign performance and recommend strategic adjustments based on results.

Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines.

Help improve internal marketing processes, workflows, systems, and playbooks.

Use AI and automation tools appropriately to improve research, analysis, and productivity without relying on AI to replace strategic thinking.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, digital marketing, account strategy, or a related role.

Strong experience developing multi-channel digital marketing strategies.

Solid understanding of SEO, content marketing, websites, social media,
 marketing, paid advertising, branding, and lead generation.

Experience managing or developing marketing strategies for multiple clients.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Comfortable communicating directly with clients and presenting strategic recommendations.

Strong organizational and project-management skills.

Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.

Agency experience is highly preferred.

Experience working with law firms, attorneys, legal marketing, or professional services is a strong plus.

Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who goes beyond completing assigned tasks. The right candidate can look at a client's business and marketing as a whole, determine what is working, what is missing, and what should happen next, and then guide the team toward measurable results.



If you're proactive, strategic, detail-oriented, comfortable working with clients, and experienced in building marketing strategies that generate real business results, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Premiere Pro & AI Tools) – Part-Time
description:
NOTE: I will check this application with an AI checker. I am a short-form video editor myself, so I will know immediately if your application was generated with ChatGPT/AI. Please write your own thoughts.



Overview

• Position: Part-Time Short-Form Video Editor

• Hours: ~20 hours per week

• Compensation: $200 / month

We are looking for a skilled, analytical video editor to take raw footage and turn it into high-performing Meta ads, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

What You Will Do

• Edit short-form videos from raw footage using Adobe Premiere Pro.

• Build high-retention video structures: strong hooks, engaging pacing/storytelling, and strategic CTA placement.

• Integrate AI tools into the workflow, including Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and AI-generated/sourced b-roll (e.g., Veo or web assets).

• Review backend analytics (retention graphs, view duration, engagement) on Instagram and YouTube to iterate and improve future edits based on performance data.

Requirements

• Expertise in Adobe Premiere Pro (Non-negotiable).

• Deep understanding of short-form video psychology (hooks, pacing, retention, CTAs).

• Experience with AI tools like ElevenLabs and Higgsfield.

• Analytical mindset—you don’t just edit; you look at the data to see what works and fix what doesn't.

• Reliable internet connection and quick turnaround time.

How to Apply

To be considered, reply with the following:

1. Portfolio Link: Share a Google Drive link with your best edited short-form videos so we can review your work quickly.

2. Your Process: Explain step-by-step how you structure and edit a short-form video from raw footage to final export (written in your own words).

Required skills and experience:



Proven, hands-on Gentran experience is essential



Experience with EDI, EDI mapping and related technologies



Experience with XML schemas and document mapping



1–2+ years implementing technical projects, with project coordination experience



Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills



Confident communicator, comfortable dealing directly with clients



Able to work independently and as part of a small team, to deadlines



Experience working within documented systems, support and escalation processes



Good working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Desirable

Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP) certification

title: Direct Response Video Editor for Meta Ads
description:
We are a Swedish e-commerce company with several brands, and we are hiring a full-time Direct Response Video Editor who can take an ad from research to finished creative.



This is NOT a role for someone who only cuts supplied footage, creates nice-looking videos, or generates obvious AI clips. You must understand performance marketing and be able to think, research, source, create and execute independently.



THE BRAND



You will initially work with Scarlet Intimates / Scarlet Flow, a Scandinavian period-underwear brand.



Our two main customer groups are:



1. Mothers buying Scarlet Flow Teen for their daughters, especially around preparing them for their first period.

2. Adult women looking for a comfortable, dry and reliable alternative to pads.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research customers, reviews, competitors and winning ads.

- Study live Scarlet Intimates and competitor creatives in Meta Ads Library.

- Identify strong angles, hooks, objections and desires.

- Write or improve direct-response scripts.

- Source or create ALL footage and assets needed for the ad.

- Create credible UGC, product visuals, voiceovers and AI assets when needed.

- Edit complete Meta ad creatives with strong pacing, captions, sound and structure.

- Analyze why creatives work or fail, then create better iterations.



We do not want generic stock footage, obvious low-quality AI, or ads assembled from whatever material is easiest to find. The finished creative must feel believable, intentional and ready to run.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Your FIRST line must be:



META EDITOR | [the editing software you personally use most]



Then include all three items below:



1. Link ONE finished direct-response e-commerce ad you personally created. Send the actual ad, not a montage or general portfolio.



2. Go to Meta Ads Library, search for Scarlet Intimates, choose ONE currently active ad and paste the Ads Library link. In three short bullet points explain:

- Who the ad targets

- What the hook/angle is

- The first thing you would improve and why



3. Confirm that you can independently source or create the content needed and complete two paid test creatives within three days.



Applications missing any of these items will not be reviewed.



PAID TEST



Selected candidates will receive a detailed Google Drive brief, brand research and a reference creative.



You will create TWO complete Swedish ad creatives:



- One Adult creative targeting adult women

- One Teen creative targeting mothers buying for their daughters



These must be completely finished ads, not concepts, scripts, drafts or quick samples.



You must:

- Read and follow the complete brief

- Study our live creatives in Meta Ads Library

- Analyze the reference creative carefully

- Do additional research yourself

- Develop the hooks, angles and scripts

- Independently source or create the footage and assets

- Create voiceover and AI material where needed

- Deliver two polished, ready-to-run advertisements



Treat the test exactly as if you were already working with us full-time. We want to see your real working standard from day one.



The test pays $50 total only if both finished creatives properly follow the complete brief and requirements. Rushed, incomplete or non-compliant submissions are not approved tests.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is a serious full-time role, not a short freelance project.



Starting salary: $400-$750/month plus performance bonuses.



If your creatives perform well, there is room for salary growth, bonuses, more responsibility and work across additional brands. We are looking for someone who wants a stable role and can grow with us for several years.



During the test you use your own tools. If hired, we provide the AI tools needed for ongoing work.

title: Low Voltage Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support — Security Systems

Two openings: Tier 1 Support  ·  Tier 2 / Tier 3 Support

About These Roles

We design, deploy, and support security and low voltage systems across commercial, residential, and municipal client sites — video surveillance, access control, intrusion, video monitoring, and the networks that carry all of it.

We are hiring two remote technical support roles. Both configure and troubleshoot live systems. The difference is depth: Tier 1 owns device and platform configuration to standard, and Tier 2/3 owns architecture, networking, escalated troubleshooting, and the technical calls that Tier 1 escalates.

Both roles are fully remote. Configuration, programming, onboarding, and troubleshooting are performed remotely in support of installation teams working on site. Occasional travel may be required for commissioning or complex turnover.

If you are strong on devices but light on networking, apply for Tier 1. 

If you can hold your own on subnetting, VLANs, point-to-point links, and system architecture, apply for Tier 2/3.

Systems and Platforms We Work With

You will not know all of these on day one. We list them so you know what the work actually involves and where your experience lines up.

Cameras and Video Surveillance

Hanwha, Axis, Digital Watchdog, Uniview, and comparable IP camera lines. Fixed, PTZ, multi-sensor, thermal, and LPR applications. Full configuration: addressing, streaming profiles, compression, exposure and image tuning, motion and analytics settings, time sync, firmware, and credential hardening.

Video Management Systems

DW Spectrum, Wisenet WAVE, and comparable VMS platforms. Camera onboarding, user and permission structures, recording schedules, retention and storage configuration, server health, licensing, and playback and export workflows.

Video Monitoring and Central Station

Immix and comparable central station monitoring platforms, plus camera-to-central bridges. Site and account setup, camera mapping, event and alarm rule configuration, arming schedules, video verification paths, and end-to-end signal path testing through to monitoring center presentation.

Video Analytics

AI and rules-based analytics platforms including server-based detection, cloud analytics, and camera-edge analytics. Detection zone and rule configuration, sensitivity tuning, false alarm reduction, and integration into the alarm pipeline.

Access Control

Brivo, PDK, and comparable cloud and on-premise access platforms. Electrified hardware including Dormakaba, ASSA ABLOY, and standard strike, maglock, and mortise applications. Door, reader, credential, schedule, group, and user configuration; controller and panel setup; and integration with video and intrusion.

Intrusion and Burglar Alarm

Ajax and comparable intrusion platforms. Panel programming, zone and partition configuration, device enrollment, user codes and arming schedules, communicator and signal path setup, and central station reporting verification.

Networking and Infrastructure

UniFi and comparable managed switching, routing, and wireless. Cellular routers and gateways, point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless links, VPN and remote access architecture, and PoE and power budgeting. Solar and battery-backed mobile surveillance units.

?How to apply — please read carefully



We are only accepting applications by
. To be considered, send your resume (PDF or Word) to 



with the subject line "System Support Tech — [Your Name]." A short note on your relevant experience is welcome.

Competency Expectations by Tier

This is what we expect you to own independently at each tier.

Area T1 — Support T2 / T3 — Support Required

Cameras & CCTV Configure cameras to standard: IP, credentials, streams, resolution, framerate, image settings, firmware. Own camera standards, storage and bandwidth sizing, multi-site design validation, and escalated image or stream faults.

Video Management (VMS) Add and configure cameras, users, recording schedules, and permissions in the VMS. Verify recording and playback. Server sizing, storage retention design, failover, licensing, VMS-to-platform integrations, and root-cause of recording loss.

Video Monitoring Onboard sites and cameras to the monitoring platform: accounts, camera mapping, event rules, arming schedules, video verification. Design monitoring account structures, tune analytics and rule logic to reduce false dispatch, and own platform integration architecture.

Analytics Enable and configure detection zones, rules, and sensitivity. Analytics tuning, model/zone strategy, and integration into the alarm pipeline.

Access Control Configure doors, readers, schedules, credentials, groups, and users. Verify door hardware operation and event reporting. System architecture, panel and controller configuration, integrations, lock and hardware troubleshooting, and vendor escalation.

Intrusion / Burg Configure zones, partitions, users, arming schedules, and communication paths. Verify signals reach central station. Panel programming, communicator and path design, integration with video and access, and escalated signal failures.

Networking Working knowledge: IP addressing, VLAN placement, PoE, switch ports, device reachability. Required: subnetting, VLAN and trunk design, routing, firewall and port forwarding, VPN, P2P and raw radio configuration, bandwidth planning.

Security Practices Change default credentials, apply firmware updates, follow the credential standard. Desired: network segmentation, least-privilege access, certificate and encryption handling, hardening standards, and remote access security.

Documentation Accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups. Define standards, review others' documentation, and produce root-cause and corrective-action records.



?

Tier 1 — Technical Support Specialist

What You'll Do

• Camera and device configuration. Configure IP cameras and edge devices to our standard — addressing, credentials, streaming profiles, resolution, framerate, bitrate, compression, image settings, motion and analytics, time sync, and firmware.

• CCTV and VMS programming. Add cameras to the VMS, build user and permission structures, set recording schedules and retention, and verify recording and playback.

• Video monitoring onboarding. Build sites and accounts in the monitoring platform, map cameras, configure event and alarm rules and arming schedules, and test that alarms present correctly to the monitoring center.

• Access control configuration. Configure doors, readers, credentials, schedules, groups, and users. Verify door hardware operates correctly and events report accurately.

• Intrusion configuration. Configure zones, partitions, users, arming schedules, and communication paths. Verify signals reach the central station.

• Remote field support. Support installation technicians over phone and video during install, configuration, testing, and turnover.

• Quality control. Verify installed devices and configurations match submittals, device schedules, and project records. Flag discrepancies.

• Documentation. Maintain accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups.

• Escalation. Escalate to Tier 2/3 with what you checked, what you ruled out, and what you think is happening.

Required

• Ability to configure IP cameras independently — addressing, streaming, credentials, and image settings — without step-by-step direction

• Working networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLAN placement, PoE, switch ports, and device reachability

• Methodical troubleshooting — the ability to isolate a fault to a layer rather than guess at it

• Ability to learn new software platforms quickly from documentation and vendor training

• Ability to read and work from drawings, device schedules, risers, and submittals

• Clear written documentation habits

• Ability to direct hands-on work over phone and video that you cannot perform yourself

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with any of the platforms listed above

• Central station monitoring platform experience (Immix or comparable)

• CompTIA A+ or Network+, or equivalent coursework

• Prior experience in security integration, low voltage, IT support, or alarm industry technical support

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30. Configure and commission cameras to standard across the manufacturers we use. Learn our naming conventions, device schedule format, and documentation standards.

Days 31–60. Independently onboard sites to the video monitoring platform and configure access control and intrusion systems on assigned projects.

Days 61–90. Own device configuration and platform onboarding for assigned projects end to end, escalating only what genuinely needs Tier 2/3.

?

Tier 2 / Tier 3 — Systems Support Engineer

This is the escalation point. When Tier 1 has exhausted what they can check, when a system is behaving in a way nobody can explain, or when a design decision needs to be made before install, this role owns it.

What You'll Do

• Escalated troubleshooting. Own faults that cross device, network, platform, and vendor boundaries. Drive them to a documented root cause rather than a workaround.

• Network architecture and configuration. Design and configure VLANs, subnets, routing, firewall rules, port forwarding, VPN tunnels, and remote access paths for security systems on customer and standalone networks.

• Point-to-point wireless. Design, align, and configure P2P and point-to-multipoint links at the radio level — raw configuration, channel and frequency planning, link budget, interference mitigation, and throughput validation.

• System design validation. Review designs, device schedules, risers, and submittals before install. Catch bandwidth, storage, power, and integration problems on paper instead of in the field.

• Integration architecture. Own integrations between video, access control, intrusion, analytics, and monitoring platforms — API, relay, and event-based.

• Security practices. Apply and enforce hardening standards: segmentation, least-privilege access, credential management, certificate and encryption handling, and secure remote access.

• Vendor escalation. Push vendor and manufacturer issues to resolution with specific findings, reproduction steps, and documented next steps.

• Technical direction. Serve as the escalation path and technical mentor for Tier 1. Review their findings and determine corrective action.

• Standards. Help build and improve configuration standards, documentation requirements, and quality control gates.

Required

• Strong hands-on experience across access control, CCTV, intrusion, and video monitoring systems

• Solid networking: subnetting, VLAN and trunk configuration, routing, DHCP and DNS, firewall rules and port forwarding, VPN, PoE budgeting, and bandwidth planning

• Point-to-point wireless experience at the configuration level — not just “we installed a link,” but aligning, tuning, and troubleshooting one

• Ability to troubleshoot across hardware, software, network, and vendor platform layers and isolate root cause

• Ability to read, review, and challenge drawings, submittals, risers, and device schedules

• Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and strong judgment on when to resolve versus escalate

• Strong documentation: issue logs, root-cause records, corrective actions, and risk summaries

• Ability to mentor and give clear technical direction to junior staff and field technicians remotely

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Desired

• Network security practices: segmentation strategy, least-privilege design, hardening standards, certificate handling, and secure remote access architecture

• CompTIA Network+ or Security+, CCNA, or equivalent certification

• Manufacturer certifications in access control, video, intrusion, or networking

• Experience with cellular gateways, VPN hub-and-spoke deployments, or standalone/off-grid system connectivity

• Scripting, API, or automation experience

• Prior experience as a lead technician, systems engineer, field engineer, or senior technical support engineer

What Success Looks Like

• Escalations come back with a root cause, not a reboot

• Design problems are caught on paper, before they cost a truck roll

• Networks are built to a standard instead of assembled per site

• Tier 1 gets better because there is a real escalation path

• Leadership stops having to personally solve every technical problem



Why These Roles

You'll own real systems, not tickets. The work spans device hardware, networking, platform configuration, and integration architecture across live client sites — with a direct line to the person setting technical direction. Both roles are fully remote, with real technical ownership and a defined path forward: Tier 1 into Tier 2/3, and Tier 2/3 into senior systems engineering.

title: Commercial Real Estate Leasing & Collections Coordinator — Part-Time, US Pacific Hours
description:
### How to Apply



Please complete our application here:





We are looking for a part-time **Real Estate / Property Management professional** to support commercial leasing, rent collections, lease renewals, and tenant coordination for a privately owned commercial real-estate portfolio in Southern California.



This is **not a passive data-entry or traditional virtual-assistant role**. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows up persistently, uses good judgment, and helps move important issues toward resolution rather than simply waiting for instructions or reporting that they are waiting on someone else.



The right person should be able to look at several open issues, determine what requires attention, gather missing information, coordinate with the people involved, and bring the owner clear recommendations or decisions when needed.



Key Responsibilities



**Commercial Leasing & Vacancies**



* Follow up on commercial vacancy inquiries.

* Coordinate with prospective tenants, brokers, and other parties involved in leasing.

* Track leasing activity, inquiries, tours, applications, proposals, and next steps.

* Follow up when leasing activity stalls and identify what is preventing progress.

* Help gather and organize information needed to evaluate leasing opportunities.

* Keep opportunities moving until they are resolved or a different strategy is approved.



**Rent Collections**



* Track tenants with overdue rent.

* Maintain clear records of communications, commitments, and follow-up dates.

* Professionally follow up with tenants regarding overdue balances and payment commitments.

* Coordinate approved notices and escalation steps using established procedures.

* Identify when an issue requires owner involvement or a different course of action.



**Lease Renewals**



* Track upcoming and expired leases.

* Research and organize market-rent information and other relevant facts for renewal decisions.

* Help prepare information so the owner can evaluate renewal rates and terms.

* Coordinate approved communications and follow-up with tenants.



**Applications & Lease Documentation**



* Collect and organize tenant applications and supporting documentation.

* Collect items such as insurance certificates, financial information, signatures, and other required documents.

* Help complete approved lease and renewal forms.

* Track outstanding documents and signatures.

* Prepare lease packages for final owner review and approval.



**Ongoing Coordination**



* Keep open issues moving rather than simply waiting for other people to respond.

* Follow up with tenants, brokers, prospects, and team members as needed.

* Identify missing information, bottlenecks, and appropriate next actions.

* Coordinate with other members of the property-management team when necessary.

* Escalate matters to the owner when judgment, approval, or a material business decision is required.



### What We Are Looking For



* **Strong written and spoken English.**

* Comfortable making professional telephone calls to U.S.-based tenants, brokers, and prospects.

* Strong follow-through and attention to detail.

* High level of ownership and accountability.

* Good judgment and ability to work independently.

* Ability to prioritize several competing issues.

* Comfortable gathering information and making recommendations rather than simply reporting problems.

* Strong proficiency with **Google Sheets and Google Docs**.

* Comfortable learning new software and processes.

* Reliable availability during U.S. Pacific business hours.



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Commercial real estate

* Property management

* Leasing

* Rent collections / accounts receivable

* Lease administration

* Yardi or similar property-management software

* QuickBooks



Direct real-estate experience is useful, but **judgment, initiative, reliability, communication, and ability to learn are more important than a particular job title or number of years of experience.**



### Hours & Schedule



This position will start at approximately **10–15 hours per week**, generally spread across Monday through Friday.



We expect roughly **2–3 hours of work per business day**.



You must have a consistent work window that falls somewhere within **8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time**. We do not require one specific shift; please tell us in your application what Pacific-Time hours you can consistently work.



Occasional flexibility for scheduled calls may be required.



The role is intended to be a **long-term part-time position**, and hours may change over time depending on workload and performance.



### Compensation



**US$6–$10/hour**, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated ability.



We are willing to pay toward the higher end of the range for someone who demonstrates strong judgment, communication, ownership, and directly relevant experience.



Payment can be made directly through **Wise**.



### How to Apply



Please complete our application here:





**Applications sent only through OnlineJobs messages without completing the application form will not be reviewed. The application process includes a short written business exercise designed to evaluate your prioritization, judgment, execution, and communication.**

title: Senior Web Developer - Local Service Sites (SEO + Conversion Copy)
description:
Plain Media LLC is a web design and digital marketing agency in Salt Lake City, Utah. We build and rank websites for local service businesses - roofers, contractors, disposal companies, home service brands. We are hiring ONE senior web developer to help us build client sites.



You'll work directly with one of our marketing consultants that has been working one-on-one with the client. You will never have to work with the client. You always work with somebody who understands web development and can get you the information that you need.



What we typically do is we will build a couple of sections and blocks for the site. We will d
 on hosting, CMS or no CMS, and how we're building it. Then we'll design the home page, service page template, area service page template, amongst a couple other key pages, and land on copy direction after we've completed keyword research and finished URL mapping. We also will typically run a listings campaign for NAP consistency. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build fast, clean marketing sites in WordPress or a modern JS framework (React, Astro, Next)

- Plan site structure and URL mapping BEFORE a single page gets built

- Collaborate and write/optimize on-page copy: titles, metas, H1s, service pages, FAQs

- Handle local SEO fundamentals: service area pages, NAP consistency, schema markup, Google Business Profile alignment

- Do keyword research and turn it into a real page map

- Use CSS animation to guide attention, not to decorate

- Build content-heavy, skimmable pages that answer the questions real customers actually ask

- Set up tracking and security: GA4, Search Console, GTM, Meta Pixel, reCAPTCHA / Cloudflare Turnstile

- Integrate CRM, build lead magnets and
 marketing integrations. 

- Landing pages and detailed GTM 



MUST HAVE

- Senior-level front end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

- WordPress AND at least one modern JS framework (React, Astro, or Next)

- Strong CSS animation skills

- On-page SEO and local SEO experience you can prove with live URLs

- Copywriting in excellent written English - headlines, service pages, CTAs that convert, PROPER HTML structure

- A real understanding of consumer psychology: why people hesitate, what makes them trust a local business, what makes them pick up the phone and how we design based on those emotions. This is the piece we care about most. Anyone can build a page. We need someone who knows why a page works and how to accomplish the sites goal.



NICE TO HAVE

- Advanced technical SEO, schema, Core Web Vitals

- Ahrefs, Semrush, or BrightLocal experience

- CRM integration, landing pages, lead magnets

- Custom embeddable widgets and calculators

- A CMS setup that lets non-technical clients edit their own content

- RankMath SEO Pro experience



ABOUT AI

You are welcome to use AI to build. We use Claude Code on most of our projects. But AI only multiplies what you already know. If you do not have a foundational grasp of proper site structure and buyer psychology on your own, the output shows it immediately - and we will notice. We have a chief web developer that will monitor output and work closely with you to align on direction. 



THE DETAILS

- Part time, 35 hours per week, long term

- $8-$10 per hour depending on skill, PLUS per-project bonuses tied to results

- Paid on time, every time

- Hours and pay grow as our client load grows

- Bonuses Available

- Hiring bonuses available

- Build your own team and be apart of a fast growing business



HOW TO APPLY - read carefully. Applications that skip these steps are deleted without reply.

1) Subject line: LOCAL RANK - [name your favorite CSS property]

2) Send 2-3 live URLs of local service business sites you built. For each one, tell me what you did and what it produced (rankings, calls, form fills). Did you work with a team and how long did it take?

3) Answer in 3-5 sentences: A homeowner lands on a roofing site the day after a hailstorm. What are the first three things that page must do to earn the call, and why?

4) Tell me your stack (WordPress or which framework) and which SEO tools you actually use week to week.

5) Tell me your available hours in US Mountain Time. Bonus if you have Friday, Saturday, Sunday availability. 



Thank YOU!

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)
description:
We are looking for a high-performance operator who understands numbers, financial data, and business operations and can work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is ideal for someone with a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, or business analysis who wants to move beyond traditional administrative work and become a strategic partner to executive leadership.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, think analytically, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do, keep reading.



Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Coordinate with accounting, finance, tax, and operations teams

-Protect your executive's time by managing priorities and follow-through

-Drive accountability across leadership initiatives

-Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements

-Translate strategy into structured execution

-Solve problems before they become emergencies



You will work closely with executive leadership and have visibility into confidential financial and business information.



Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential.



Preferred Background



We're especially interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



-U.S. Tax Preparation or Tax Operations

-Public Accounting

-Bookkeeping

-Accounting or Finance

-Financial Analysis

-Business Analytics

-Audit or Compliance

-Controller or Accounting Support

-Executive Assistant supporting Finance or Executive Leadership



Experience with tools such as QuickBooks, Excel/Google Sheets, financial reporting software, or tax software is highly preferred.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



-Needs constant reassurance or supervision

-Struggles with direct feedback

-Prefers slow-moving corporate environments

-Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

-Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

-Is uncomfortable working with numbers, financial data, or business systems

-Frequently changes jobs every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment where ownership matters.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Within your first 90 days, you will:



-Organize and improve financial and operational reporting

-Build dashboards and executive reports that improve decision-making

-Support leadership with accurate accounting and tax-related insights

-Improve reporting processes across departments

-Run executive meetings with clear agendas and follow-up

-Anticipate leadership needs before they arise

-Track priorities and hold teams accountable

-Bring solutions, not just problems

-Operate calmly and effectively under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



-Have experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, U.S. tax, or business analysis

-Understand financial statements, reconciliations, reporting, and business metrics

-Have supported a founder, executive, or finance leader

-Have remained in at least one meaningful role for three or more years

-Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes

-Are highly organized and analytical

-Communicate clearly and professionally

-Maintain composure under pressure

-Think in terms of business outcomes, not just completing tasks



You are someone who:



-Spots financial or operational issues before others do

-Brings clarity where others see complexity

-Takes initiative without waiting to be asked

-Uses data to support better business decisions



Compensation & Growth



This role offers:



-Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

-Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making

-The opportunity to influence business operations and financial processes

-Long-term career growth as DAP Brands continues to scale



At DAP Brands, we reward impact, ownership, and results, not simply tenure.



Final Note



This opportunity is for someone who wants to grow beyond a traditional Executive Assistant role and become a trusted business partner to executive leadership.



If you have a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or financial operations and enjoy solving problems, improving systems, and helping leaders execute at a high level, we'd love to hear from you.



If you're looking for a slow-paced, highly structured corporate environment, this probably isn't the right fit.



But if you're excited to work alongside leadership, make data-driven decisions, and help build something meaningful, apply through our careers page 
/careers and write "MAVERICK" before your name.

title: Sales Representative

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other team members can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Executive Assistant / Online Business Manager (Right-Hand to the Founder)
description:
Hi, I'm Renee. I am building my own business called Renee Firth Co. It is all about me and my work. It has a few parts:



One on one coaching

ASD Mum Club, a club for mums who have kids with autism

Live events

Speaking on stage

A podcast. This is my long form content. People can watch it on YouTube or listen on the podcast apps.



The parts may change over time. Some may grow. Some may stop. But I stay in the middle of it all. I need someone calm and steady by my side as it grows.



A bit about my team. We are small. Right now it is me and a couple of helpers. We all wear a few hats. And we get a lot done. I want that from you too. Someone who jumps in and makes things happen.



I am looking for my right-hand helper, an Executive Assistant. Over time it can grow into an Online Business Manager. That just means the person who runs the day to day of the whole business, so I can stay on the big picture. Someone I can trust to keep things going when I am busy. And to hold the fort if I am ever sick or away. This is not just simple admin. I want someone who can run things so nothing stops when I step back.



Here is how it works. You will start small, about 5 hours a week, looking after my social media and my Circle community. As you settle in and I trust you more, your hours will grow, your pay will grow, and you will take on more of the list below. So even though we start small, I need someone who can grow into all of it. Please only apply if that excites you.



What you would help me with (this is the whole role over time):



Keep things running behind the scenes when I cannot. The day to day jobs that keep the business going.

Upload my content. Podcast episodes, and blog posts on WordPress.

Be my social media manager on Instagram. Post my content, reply to comments, and do a little daily engagement in my voice. About 15 minutes a day is plenty for Instagram.

Upload and schedule my other social content too. YouTube, TikTok, and
.

Look after Pinterest. Make and schedule pins that bring people to our website.

Send my
 newsletters in Kit.

Look after our Circle community, where our membership lives. Post my content there, welcome new people, send them their welcome
s and forms, reply kindly, and keep it warm and active.

Run my fortnightly Zoom sessions. Sometimes you host on camera. Sometimes you set up and run the tech while I lead. Then download the recording and upload it where it goes.

Work with the person who hosts my online workshops to line up dates and times for the next ones.

Look after the inbox, calendar, bookings, reminders, and confirmations.

Help plan the podcast and live events behind the scenes, not run them. Things like show notes, booking guests, and getting quotes from venues ahead of time. You would not run events on the day. I will have someone else for that.

Keep projects and to do lists on track so things happen on time.

Be my calm assistant when I am away, so nothing important gets missed.



What I am looking for in you:



You are organised. You finish what you start.

You are warm and kind when you talk to people. This matters a lot. Many of the people we help are mums going through a hard time.

You can take things on yourself. You make smart, informed choices on your own.

You are calm and steady. I need to trust you with a lot.

You speak and write clear, friendly English.

You are good with AI tools, mainly Claude, and also ChatGPT. You use them to work faster and smarter. Things like drafting, tidying writing, sorting ideas, and making our whole workflow smoother.

You are happy to start with a few tasks and grow into the whole role.

It helps if you have worked for a digital business before.



Tools we use:



Kit for our
 newsletters

WordPress for our blog

Circle for our membership community

Instagram, YouTube, TikTok,
, and Pinterest for social

Zoom for our sessions

Claude and ChatGPT for working smarter, mainly Claude

Gmail for our inbox

Google Calendar for my diary

Google Drive for our files

Slack, so you and I can chat easily

Our website, 



Hours:



About 5 hours a week to start, looking after my social media and my Circle community.

Your hours and pay will grow over time as you take on more and as I trust you with more.

Also more during busy times, or when I am sick or away.



How to apply:



Well done for reading this far. That already tells me something good about you. Here is what to do:



1. Start your reply with the word "Sunflower". That way I know you read the whole thing.



2. Tell me about a time you kept things going while the boss was away.



3. Many of the mums we help are tired and stretched. They love their kids with autism to bits, but some days are really hard. Picture one of these mums finding our little community. What would you want her to feel? And tell me why helping mums like her matters to you.



4. Tell me in a few plain words why this job feels right for you.



5. If we go forward, I will ask you to do one quick free personality test before we chat.



I read every reply myself. I can't wait to find the right person.



Thank you, Renee

title: Short-Form Video Editor for social media
description:
We run an Instagram page built around Mel, a dog groomer character who specializes in doodles. Mel isn't a real person — she's fully AI-generated. Every video is made in Veo 3.



The page is growing and the bottleneck is production. We need someone who can sit down, generate, and deliver finished Reels without us hand-holding every prompt.



What you'll do:



Generate 6–10 finished Reels per week (20–40 seconds each) in Veo 3

Keep Mel consistent — same face, same hair, same salon, same voice, every single video. This is the hardest part of the job and the main thing we're hiring for.

Build scenes around a simple brief we give you: a dog, a grooming problem, a transformation, a product moment

Iterate on prompts until the shot is right. Most usable clips take several generations — that's expected, not a failure.

Assemble clips into a finished vertical Reel: pacing, cuts, captions, sound

Fix the AI tells before delivery — warped hands, morphing dogs, text glitches, uncanny motion. If it looks like AI slop, it doesn't ship.

Deliver in 9:16, ready to post, on a set weekly schedule

Track what works — pull IG insights and our affiliate numbers into a simple weekly sheet so we know which hooks and formats to make more of



What you're NOT doing: no posting (we publish), no writing captions or affiliate links, no customer messages. Produce and report — that's the role.



Tools — we provide everything:



You'll get logins for our Veo 3 access, editing software, and voice tools. You don't need to pay for anything. You do need a computer and internet that can handle generating and downloading video all day.



What we're looking for:



Hands-on Veo 3 experience. Not "I've used AI tools" — actual Veo 3 or Flow output you can show us.

A real method for character consistency across generations. If you know why this is hard, you're the person we want. If you don't, this role will frustrate both of us.

Strong prompt writing — you can describe a camera angle, a lighting setup, and a dog's coat texture in a way the model actually follows

Video editing in CapCut, Premiere, or Resolve — enough to cut, caption, and sound-design a Reel

Taste. You can tell the difference between a video that looks real and one that looks like AI. Most people can't.

Patient and systematic. This job is 80% iteration. Someone who gets discouraged by bad generations will hate it.

Comfortable with basic spreadsheets for the weekly performance report

A few hours of overlap with US Eastern Time

Good written English

Bonus: you know dogs, or you're willing to learn what a badly groomed doodle actually looks like



The setup:



20 hours per week, part-time, long-term

₱28,000 – ₱40,000/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

Paid trial project before we commit long-term (details below)

Clear briefs, weekly check-in, no micromanaging



How to apply:



Send us:



Links to AI-generated video you personally made — Veo 3, Flow, Kling, Runway, Sora, whatever. Vertical short-form preferred. Tell us which model and what your prompt approach was.

Your answer to this: How do you keep the same character looking identical across 10 different AI-generated videos? Two or three sentences. We're testing whether you've actually done this.

Roughly how many generations it takes you to get one usable 8-second clip, honestly.

Your available hours in Philippine time.

Start your message with the word "DOODLE" so we know you read the post.



No video samples, no review. We're hiring one person for the long haul, so put a little effort in — we will too.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS (tag these on the listing)



Video Editing · AI Video Generation · Prompt Engineering · Content Creation · Instagram · CapCut · Adobe Premiere Pro · Social Media Marketing · Attention to Detail

title: Land Acquisitions Manager Make up to $100K per year.
description:
Make up to $100k a year (Uncapped  Commission)



*THE ROLE*



You get on the phone with landowners, do real discovery to understand what they actually need, and propose the solution that solves it. You close, and you get paid on every deal that closes. Uncapped. The better you serve the seller, the more you close, and the more you make. That is the whole deal.



The people you help are usually landowners who inherited a piece of land, or bought it decades ago for a plan that never happened, and now it is just a bill and a worry they would like to be rid of. A lot of them have been burned before by someone who made a promise and vanished. They do not want a hard sell. They want an honest person who makes it simple and does exactly what they said they would.



Your job is to be that person, and here that's a specific kind of selling. You start by digging for what's really driving them, the real reason the land became a weight, not the surface answer. Then you help them see a way out they can trust. You win on trust, not pressure, and never by being the highest number. Price is a threshold to clear, not the lever you pull. The skill is getting a guarded, been-burned seller to a decision they'll feel good about long after the call. The reps who care the most close the most, because sellers can feel the difference between being served and being sold.



The standard for this seat is 4 signed deals a month.



*SKILLS NEEDED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE*



- Fluent in speaking and writing English with minimal accent.

- Proven expertise with Land Insights, Land Portal, Land ID, Zillow, and Redfin for property comparables and research.

- Experience with Google Workspace, DocuSign, and CRM systems like Stride or Pebble.





*KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*



- Research land opportunities using GIS, public records, and online data sources.

- Analyze zoning, land use, density, and development code.

- Contact local planning & zoning departments to confirm zoning and development standards.

- Organize diligence materials and flag risks early.





*APPLICATION PROCESS*

Submit your resume.

Submit a video introducing yourself and also answer the following questions in the video as well (Loom or equivalent).



What is your experience using Land Insights, Land Portal, Land ID, Zillow or Redfin?

Have previously you worked in land investing or wholesaling real estate? If yes, describe your role.

If a Land seller tells you he want s to sell his 1 acre parcel for $40,000 but the land is worth $15,000. How do you negotiate with the seller?



*IMPORTANT*

*No video submission, your application will be discarded*



This a Fully commission role. No Base Salary.

Other shifts may be available

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of resumes.

• Ability to work efficiently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Previous experience in resume screening recruitment in the US is a MUST

• LONG TERM PROJECT

• Collaborative team culture with opportunities for growth and development.

title: Website Editor/Assistant w/ AI (Hostinger)
description:
** Please Read Entire Post Before Contacting **



* Must have ChatGPT Pro (or I can provide as long as you have basic knowledge on using ChatGPT)



Hello, currently in need of a website editor / assistant that can make simple edits. I am making 40+ business sites that simply need a form to request a quote. I have made about 50 so far, and they take about 10-15 minutes each to review and edit.



Hostinger's AI can generate the whole site with a simple prompt, and then you just have to go through to make sure it looks fine based on the style that I will show in the tutorial video.



The process is:



1) Create the Hostinger AI site with provided prompt that you will put into ChatGPT to receive a 700-character prompt to put into Hostinger AI to generate the site.



2) Review the generated site:



Check the homepage

Navigation

Contact/Request Pricing buttons

Images (generate the alt text for pictures with the Hostinger AI, takes a few seconds)

Product terminology

Remove anything obviously incorrect

Add the form to a few pages



3) Make the standardized edits



Company/site name


Phone

Request Pricing form

Footer

About/contact information

Any obvious AI-generated errors



Then the site is done and you can move on to the next site. I have a video showing the process. Each sites is 6-7 pages and you just have to go through them to make sure everything is correct.



Do not try to redesign the website. Follow the process exactly. The goal is a professional, fast, functional website that is ready to rank, not a perfect website.

title: Operations Transformation Lead/Operations Builder
description:
Operations Transformation Lead

Full-Time | U.S. EST Hours | Remote (Philippines Only)

________________________________________

About Us

We are a U.S.-based due diligence and research company serving attorneys, lenders, title companies, financial institutions, and corporate clients nationwide since 2002.

We help clients obtain critical business, legal, corporate, and public records information used in lending, legal, compliance, real estate, and corporate transactions throughout the United States.

We are currently rebuilding significant portions of our operational infrastructure, processes, systems, and team structure.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of an established company that is entering its next phase of growth and transformation.

________________________________________

This Is Not a Traditional Operations Role

We are not looking for someone to maintain an operation that is already fully built.

We are looking for someone who can help build it.

This role is for a builder, problem solver, and operational leader who enjoys creating structure, accountability, visibility, and scalable systems where they do not yet exist.

You should enjoy:

•	Building processes from the ground up

•	Creating order from complexity

•	Solving operational challenges

•	Leading change and improvement initiatives

•	Driving accountability and execution

•	Helping organizations scale

If you prefer highly structured environments where everything is already documented and defined, this role is probably not the right fit.

________________________________________

Your Mission

Work directly with ownership to help transform a founder-led service company into a scalable, system-driven organization capable of delivering operational excellence, accountability, consistency, and sustainable growth.

Over time, this role is expected to become a key leadership position within the organization, helping shape team structure, performance standards, reporting frameworks, operational governance, and the systems that support future growth.

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to create operational structure, accountability, visibility, scalability, and measurable business improvement.

________________________________________

•	Analyze and document how work currently moves through the organization

•	Design and implement scalable operational workflows

•	Build accountability, reporting, and performance management systems

•	Establish KPIs, scorecards, and operational visibility

•	Develop SOPs, operational standards, and governance frameworks

•	Identify bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for improvement

•	Support team development, performance, and accountability

•	Partner with leadership on strategic initiatives and operational priorities

•	Help build the operational foundation required for future growth and scalability

•	Help establish scalable operational processes that support business development, client growth, and future expansion

________________________________________

What We're Looking For

Required

•	Experience building, designing, or improving systems and processes from scratch

•	Experience leading remote teams

•	Strong leadership — able to hold staff accountable and train new hires

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills

•	Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities

•	High level of ownership and accountability

•	Ability to operate independently and drive execution

•	Comfortable working in an environment where not every process is already defined

•	Resourceful, independent, proactive — a problem-solver who creates order where none exists

Strongly Preferred

•	Startup, entrepreneurial, or high-growth business experience

•	Experience working directly with U.S.-based teams, business owners, clients, or organizations

•	Experience supporting distributed or international teams across multiple time zones

•	Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience

•	Experience implementing KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and accountability systems

•	Experience managing through organizational change or growth

•	Experience with AI tools, automation platforms, and operational technology

________________________________________

You Will Likely Thrive Here If

•	You naturally take ownership

•	You enjoy building systems and solving problems

•	You think in processes rather than tasks

•	You can balance strategic thinking with practical execution

•	You are comfortable making decisions and driving initiatives forward

•	You have successfully improved an operation, department, or business rather than simply maintained one

________________________________________

Important

Candidates who have only managed established processes and teams without experience building, improving, or transforming operations are unlikely to be successful in this role.

We are looking for builders, not caretakers.

________________________________________

Compensation & Growth

Starting at $1,500 USD/month.

Higher compensation may be available based on experience, leadership capability, industry expertise, and demonstrated results.

Performance bonuses and long-term advancement opportunities are available for exceptional performers.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable Specialist with hands-on experience managing AR for large national retail accounts. This role goes beyond basic invoice processing — you will own the end-to-end AR cycle for our key retail partners, with a strong focus on chargeback investigation, dispute resolution, and deduction management. The ideal candidate has direct experience working with EDI-based retailers and understands the operational nuances of selling to major big-box and off-price chains.



Key Responsibilities

National Retail Account AR Management

Own and manage all AR activity for national retail accounts including Target, Walmart, TJX Companies (T.J. Maxx / Marshalls), Ross Stores, Nordstrom, and similar major retailers

Monitor open invoices, track payment timelines, and reconcile remittance advice against expected payments

Coordinate with retailer portals (e.g., Target POL, Walmart Retail Link, SPS Commerce) to pull invoices, remittance data, and deduction detail

Ensure timely and accurate cash application for high-volume payment batches



Chargeback & Deduction Management

Identify, categorize, and track all chargebacks and deductions received from national retail accounts

Investigate the root cause of each deduction — including shortage claims, compliance violations (routing, labeling, PO violations), pricing discrepancies, and late shipments

Compile supporting documentation (BOLs, PO confirmations, ASNs, carrier confirmations) and submit formal disputes through retailer portals

Follow up on open disputes through resolution and maintain a running aging report of contested deductions

Work cross-functionally with logistics, operations, and sales teams to prevent recurring chargeback issues



Reconciliation & Reporting

Perform monthly AR reconciliation and ensure books are clean and current in QuickBooks Online

Prepare weekly/monthly AR aging reports by retailers and escalate high-risk items to management

Support month-end close activities, including AR sub-ledger reconciliation and journal entry support

Maintain organized records of all invoices, remittances, deduction communications, and dispute outcomes



Cross-Functional Coordination

Liaise with 3PL partners, freight carriers, and internal operations to gather evidence for dispute packages

Communicate professionally with retailer AP teams to resolve payment discrepancies

Collaborate with the supply chain finance team (e.g., Chase Supply Chain Finance) to ensure AR records align with funded invoices



Qualifications

Required

3–5 years of AR experience with a strong focus on national retail / wholesale accounts

Direct experience with at least two of the following: Target, Walmart, TJX, Ross Stores, Nordstrom, or comparable big box / off-price retailers

Proven track record of managing and disputing chargebacks and deductions

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or ERP accounting software

Experience navigating retailer portals (e.g., Target POL, Retail Link, SPS Commerce, or similar EDI/portal environments)

Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data reconciliation)

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage high-volume, detail-intensive work

title: Accounts Payable Specialist - US Property Management Company | Remote Position
description:
About Superior Property Group



Superior Property Group is where real estate gets done right. We manage rentals, condo associations, and HOAs across Madison and southern Wisconsin — with the transparency, structure, and straight talk that property owners and residents actually deserve.



Our team spans the United States, Mexico, the Philippines, and Pakistan. We're a hands-on team that values clear communication and reliability — and we believe in empowering our team to do great work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.



About the Role



Do you love a clean set of books, and the quiet satisfaction of catching a mistake before it becomes a problem? Are you looking for a role where precision genuinely matters and your work is felt across the whole company, not just one desk?

We're bringing our accounts payable process fully in-house, and we're looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to own it. You'll be the person standing between an incoming vendor bill and an accurate, on-time payment — reviewing invoices, coding them to the right property, running the weekly payment batch, and making sure nothing gets missed, duplicated, or paid to the wrong place. What you enter here shows up on owner and resident statements, so accuracy isn't a nice-to-have — it's the job.



You'll work across Rentvine, Ramp, Property Meld, and QuickBooks Online, and you'll be trusted to make the call on routing, flag anything that looks off, and follow through until it's resolved rather than letting it sit. Our AP process is partially documented and still evolving, so you'll work closely with our bill-processing lead to help build out the SOPs as you learn the role.



If you're organized, detail-driven, and take pride in getting it right the first time, you'll play a key role in protecting how our clients see their investment — and you'll be trusted to run a real function, not just execute someone else's checklist.



What You'll Do



Daily

Monitoring the bills inbox for incoming vendor and utility invoices (electronic and scanned)

Reviewing each invoice for completeness — property address, vendor, invoice number, amount, description — before processing anything incomplete

Confirming the property is still actively managed by the company, and checking vendor status/W-9/COI in Rentvine before onboarding a new vendor

Checking for duplicate invoices (by invoice number, amount, and existing bills on file) before forwarding anything

Determining whether an invoice is tied to a maintenance work order (Meld) and routing it through the correct flow — standard bills inbox vs. Meld + Ramp

Fielding vendor questions about invoices and payment status



Weekly

Processing the weekly vendor payment run — checks and remote checks issued through Rentvine, ACH on its own schedule 

Coding and finalizing draft bills in Rentvine — payee, dates, invoice number, memo, description, payer, GL account, and amount
