title: Mental Health Enrollment/New Patient Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Enrollment Specialist, Intake Coordinator, Patient Care Coordinator, New Client Coordinator



Location: Virtual

Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Job

Pacific Mind Health is an established outpatient mental health practice seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and compassionate professional to join our virtual team. We are committed to providing a patient-centered healthcare experience built on respect, integrity, teamwork, and exceptional service.



As a Patient Intake, Enrollment & Care Coordinator, you will play a critical role in helping patients access care by supporting the new patient journey from initial inquiry through scheduling and onboarding. This position requires strong communication skills (English), attention to detail, and the ability to provide a professional and compassionate experience for patients seeking mental health services.



Your work will directly support timely access to high-quality care by ensuring accurate patient enrollment, efficient scheduling, insurance verification, and seamless coordination between patients, providers, and internal teams.



This is a full-time remote position, working Monday through Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. Candidates must be available during Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours.



Key Responsibilities

• Conduct new patient screenings and intake assessments (mental health experience required).

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective and new patients, providing a welcoming and supportive experience.

• Communicate with patients regarding available services, including Interventional Psychiatry treatments such as TMS and Spravato.

• Gather and accurately document patient demographic, clinical, and insurance information.

• Coordinate and schedule initial consultations, follow-up appointments, and procedures.

• Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage requirements, and financial responsibilities.

• Review and collect required patient intake forms, consent forms, and supporting documentation.

• Follow up with patients regarding incomplete paperwork, missing information, or outstanding requirements.

• Assist patients with questions regarding practice policies, procedures, services, and next steps in their care journey.

• Collaborate closely with clinical and administrative teams to ensure efficient patient transitions and high-quality care coordination.

• Maintain accurate records within electronic medical record (EMR) systems and related platforms.

• Support improvements to intake workflows, scheduling processes, and overall patient experience.

• Perform additional administrative responsibilities as assigned.



Qualifications

• 3+ years of recent mental health medical office experience required.

• Minimum of 1 year of experience in patient intake, enrollment, care coordination, or new patient onboarding.

• Licensed nurse or clinical healthcare background preferred.

• Experience with mental health services, psychiatric practices, or specialty healthcare settings strongly preferred.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to provide compassionate, professional, and patient-focused experience.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection required.



Additional Skills & Competencies

• Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written (English) communication with patients, providers, and external vendors through phone,
, and virtual platforms.

• Patient Experience: Ability to build trust with patients, explain processes clearly, and provide support throughout the intake and scheduling experience.

• Self-Motivation & Accountability: Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working independently as part of a remote healthcare team.

• Organization & Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and maintain accuracy while handling multiple patient requests.

• Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using:

• Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems (e.g., Tebra, Kipu, DrChrono)

• Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

• CRM, phone system and workflow management tools (e.g., Asana, HubSpot, Dialpad)

• Dropbox and other cloud-based tools

• HIPAA Compliance: Strong understanding of patient privacy, confidentiality, and healthcare compliance requirements.

• Patient Insurance & Financial Communication: Ability to explain insurance benefits, patient financial responsibilities, and billing-related questions in a clear and professional manner.



Applications Instructions

If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly ask that you submit a brief video introduction that includes:



• A short introduction about yourself.

• Your current role or professional background.

• An overview of your relevant experience and qualifications.

• What you are looking for in your next role.

• Why are you interested in Pacific Mind Health.

• Why you believe you are a strong fit for this position.

• Your availability, preferred working hours, and time zone.



In addition to your video submission, please complete your application through the OnlineJobs.ph platform.



You may submit your video through
 at 
 or provide a secure video link through Dropbox, Google Drive, or another file-hosting platform.



We appreciate your interest in joining Pacific Mind Health and look forward to reviewing your application. Qualified candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.



About Pacific Mind Health

Our mission is to deliver exceptional, patient-centered mental health care through innovation, compassion, and evidence-based treatments. We foster a supportive and inclusive environment, where both our patients and team members can thrive. Our goal is to be an oasis of healing and a sanctuary of hope, empowering individuals to achieve whole-person wellness.



We embrace understanding, flexibility, and responsiveness as we provide compassionate and empathetic care, leveraging the latest advancements in Psychiatry. Our goal is to improve mental health outcomes, reduce stigma, and provide comprehensive treatment options tailored to each patient’s needs.



Our Values

• Compassion – Empathetic, Patient-Centered Care

• Growth – Continuous Learning & Employee Development

• Integrity – Honesty, Trust, & Ethical practices

• Teamwork – Collaboration & Respect

• Excellence – Raising the Standard of Care



Work with us to help people Feel Better. Live Better.

title: Email Support E-Commerce Brand
description:
Part-time
 support (AI writes the replies, about 1 hour a day)



Simple, steady side work. You handle customer
s for us with an AI bot that does the writing for you.



How it works:

An AI bot is connected to our Outlook inbox. It reads each new
 and drafts the reply. Your job is to check that draft, fix anything odd, and send it. Most days the whole job is copy, paste, send.



Your daily routine (about 1 hour):

• Open Outlook once a day, around the same time

• Go through the new
s

• Paste in the bot's reply, give it a quick read, send

• Fix small mistakes: wrong name, weird phrasing, info that's clearly off

• If the bot ever promises something (refund, price, delivery date), don't send it. Flag it to me first

• Forward anything the bot can't answer to me with a one-line note



That's it. Some days it's 30 minutes.



Requirements:

• STRONG English. You're the last person to see the
 before the customer does. When the bot writes something broken, you're the one who catches it

• Attention to detail. Pasting the wrong reply into the wrong thread is the only real way to fail this job

• Reliable. The inbox gets handled every single day, weekends included. It's one hour, not a burden

• Own computer and good internet

• Comfortable with Outlook and basic copy-paste work

• Wise or Revolut for payment

• PH or similar time zone

DÄT Chocolate

The better your creative performs, the more you can earn—with no fixed cap on your upside.

Brand and customer storytelling

Problem-and-solution concepts

Direct-response sales videos

New creative formats that other food and wellness brands are not using

Who We’re Looking For

Have a strong portfolio of AI-generated video content

Understand performance creative and direct-response marketing

Are passionate about using creativity to generate measurable sales

How to Apply

Whether you are applying as an individual creator or an agency

Your portfolio and strongest AI-generated videos

Any experience creating performance content for e-commerce brands

Examples of advertisements that generated measurable results

Why you are passionate about performance creative

The AI tools and creative platforms you use

Your weekly creative capacity

How you would approach creating content for chocolate and protein powder

When we win you win! We want to be an 8 figure brand and if you can contribute lots of money to be made!

title: Amazon Seller Central VA
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Seller Central-focused Virtual Assistant to manage and optimize Amazon outbound shipment workflows. This role requires strong operational execution inside Amazon Seller Central, with a focus on shipment creation, shipment cost tracking, logistics coordination, inventory management, and placement fee analysis. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, understands Amazon shipment methods including SPD, LTL, and FTL, and can accurately analyze shipment costs to support operational and financial decision-making.



Seller Central Shipment Management

This role is responsible for creating and managing Amazon shipment plans based on client-provided SKU and quantity requests. The successful candidate will coordinate shipments using SPD, LTL, and FTL methods, verify shipment accuracy, routing, carton counts, pallet configurations, and warehouse destinations, while proactively monitoring shipment statuses and resolving discrepancies. Maintaining accurate shipment documentation and tracking records is a critical part of the position.



Shipment Cost Analysis & Reporting

The candidate will review and analyze placement fees, transportation costs, split shipment impacts, and cost-per-unit shipping metrics. They will identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency while preparing recurring shipment cost summaries and reports that support business decision-making.



Data & Inventory Management

Responsibilities include maintaining accurate inventory levels across multiple warehouses and ensuring data consistency across reports. The role requires advanced use of Excel and Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, forecasting, and shipment planning. Strong attention to detail and data accuracy is essential.



Logistics Coordination

The successful candidate will coordinate with warehouses, prep centers, freight carriers, and internal teams to ensure smooth shipment execution. This includes scheduling and monitoring pickups and deliveries, assisting with freight coordination, and communicating shipment updates, delays, and exceptions clearly and promptly.



Required Qualifications

Candidates should have hands-on experience working inside Amazon Seller Central and a strong understanding of Amazon shipment workflows. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets is required, along with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. The ability to work independently, manage repetitive operational tasks with a high degree of accuracy, and communicate effectively in writing is essential. Candidates who are detail-oriented and follow instructions carefully tend to excel in this role. When submitting your application, start the subject line with Capybara followed by your name.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating FTL freight shipments, familiarity with freight portals and logistics software, and knowledge of inventory planning and supply chain operations are highly valued. Additional experience with SPS Commerce, EDI workflows, Amazon B2B operations, routing requests, ASN management, retailer compliance requirements, freight appointments, carrier communications, and Vendor Central workflows will be considered an advantage.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
How to Apply



Subject line: "Full-Time VA - [Your Name]"



Record a short video, 2 to 4 minutes, answering the following five questions:



1. Can you work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday? Tell us what your setup looks like for working these hours consistently, including your internet and backup power situation.



2. Walk us through your VA experience. Who did you work for, what did you handle day to day, and why did that role end?



3. What experience do you have with real estate, real estate media, photo editing, or quality control? If you have Photoshop experience, describe the kind of edits you've done.



4. You have several projects going at once, some with tighter deadlines than others. At 3:00 PM you realize you won't finish everything before you log off at 5:00. What do you do?



5. You're managing our inbox and text line, editing photos, and helping with admin tasks, all in the same day. How do you d
 what gets done first when everything feels urgent?



Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



About Our Company



We are a US based media company, serving real estate agents. We create photo and video content that is used as media assets to help agents market the homes they are selling.



The Role



We're looking for an experienced VA who can help run day-to-day tasks.



This is a wide role. Some days you're handling booking requests and client revisions. Some days you're in Photoshop drawing lot lines. Some days you're handling whatever the Founder needs extra help with. We need someone who can switch between all of it and stay organized.



Client Communication, Booking & Scheduling (50%)



Manage the business phone line (texting only, no phone communication) and inbound
 for booking requests

Schedule shoots and coordinate photographer calendars

Handle revision requests from clients and route them to the editing team

Answer routine client questions using our documented responses

Send booking confirmations, reminders, and delivery notifications

Keep the CRM accurate and up to date



Photo Editing & Quality Control (25%)



Digital lot line drawings

Object and item removals

Light Photoshop corrections including exposure, straightening, and color balance

Work with our AI editing tools, including Higgsfield

Quality check photography against our checklists before delivery



Admin & Founder Support (25%)



General administrative tasks as they come up

Personal scheduling and calendar management for the Founder

Invoice processing and project tracking

Documentation and file organization

Whatever the business needs that week



Working Hours



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday.



That is roughly 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time. The exact window shifts by one hour when the US changes for daylight saving. You must be able to work this schedule consistently.



What We're Looking For



Required:



Prior VA experience with a US-based business

Extreme attention to detail. You notice what others miss

Exceptional written and spoken English. Professional, clear, warm

Process-oriented. You follow checklists and documentation without cutting corners

Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

Our Tools

 for project management

 for video review

Training provided for all platforms.

Real growth as the company scales

title: Global Supply Chain & Operations Lead
description:
Global Supply Chain & Operations Lead



Focus: Demand Planning, Fulfillment & Regional Compliance



About the Role



We're looking for the architect of our global hardware fulfillment operation. You'll ensure our resellers across LATAM, North America, and EMEA never experience a stockout, that our hardware compliance (NOM, ANATEL, CE) stays ahead of our sales expansion, and that our purchasing strategy balances margin against lead-time risk. This is not a coordination role — you will own the physical supply chain end to end.



Key Responsibilities



Global Demand Planning

Transform historical sales data into a rolling 6–12 month forecast. Determine what we order, when, and from which origin (China vs. Houston) to optimize for both cost and speed.



Country Coordination & Compliance

Lead market-entry operations for new countries — mapping required certifications, import hurdles, tax/duty implications, and local SIM/data provider sourcing.



Vendor Management

Own the relationship with our primary hardware partners (e.g., Streamax), including negotiating reorder points, buffer stock requirements, and SLA compliance.



Process Automation

Maintain our Fulfillment Live Tracker and use AI and low-code tools (Zapier/Make) to build workflows that flag backorder risk before it becomes a customer-facing issue.



What Success Looks Like

Operational Rigor — You act on data, not just report it. If a SKU shows 20 days of supply against a 40-day lead time, the purchase order is already being drafted before it comes up in a meeting.



Global Fluency — You understand that logistics in Brazil are not the same as logistics in Canada, and you navigate tradeoffs like China drop-ship margin vs. local warehouse speed instinctively.



Builder Mindset — You treat manual processes as a problem to solve. You use AI to automate reporting, status updates, and vendor communications so you can focus on strategy.



Requirements

Proven experience in demand planning, inventory forecasting, or supply chain management, ideally in hardware/physical goods

Experience navigating multi-country compliance, customs, and import/export regulations

Comfort with vendor negotiation and SLA management

Practical experience using AI tools and/or low-code automation platforms (Zapier, Make, or similar) to streamline operational workflows

Strong async communication skills and ability to work across time zones

Spanish or Portuguese fluency is a strong plus, given our LATAM focus

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field preferred

title: Family Law Intake Specialist
description:
When someone calls a family law firm, it is usually one of the worst weeks of their life. You are the first person they talk to. That call d
 whether they feel steadied or whether they hang up and call someone else.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely good at that moment. Warm, organized, unflappable, and fast on the follow-up. *Bonus if you have used Lawmatics or a similar crm.*



About us



Edwards Family Law is a Georgia family law firm handling divorce, custody, support, and Guardian ad Litem work. We are small, we move quickly, and we care a lot about how clients are treated from the very first contact. Our team runs lean, which means your work is visible and your judgment matters.



What you will actually do

• Answer incoming calls, web leads, and referral inquiries, usually within minutes, not hours

• Listen. Ask good questions. Get the facts we need without making the caller feel processed

• Screen potential clients against our case criteria and run conflict checks

• Schedule consultations and make sure people actually show up (reminders, confirmations, rescheduling)

• Keep the CRM immaculate: every lead logged, every note current, every follow-up scheduled

• Send engagement letters and fee agreements, track signatures, and hand off cleanly to the legal team

• Follow up with leads who did not book, respectfully and persistently

• Track intake numbers and tell us what you are seeing: where leads come from, where they stall, what we should change



Who this is for

• 2+ years in intake, client services, sales, admissions, patient coordination, or another role where you talked to people in stressful situations all day

• You can hear someone cry on the phone and stay steady and useful

• You are ridiculously organized. Nothing falls through. Nothing sits in a folder for three days

• You write clean, professional
s without being asked to fix them

• You are comfortable talking about money, because you will be quoting retainers

• You can work independently without someone checking on you at 2:00 p.m.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a private, quiet workspace (confidentiality is not optional here)

Nice to have: family law or legal experience, CRM/practice management software experience, Spanish fluency.

Not required: a paralegal certificate or a law degree. 



What we offer

• Fully remote, with a real team you actually talk to

• Direct access to the attorney; no layers of bureaucracy

• Training on family law intake and Georgia practice specifics

• Work that matters. You will help people take the first step out of a hard situation





How to apply

Send your resume and a short note to this site. In the note, tell us about a time you handled an upset or emotional person and what you did. Two paragraphs is plenty. We read every one.

title: Executive Operations Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Operations Coordinator to support the executive and leadership team of two growing U.S.-based businesses:

A tax and accounting firm serving more than 3,000 clients

A small digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, Google Ads, websites, and digital growth



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys organizing chaos, improving systems, following up with people, and making sure important things never fall through the cracks.

You should be the type of person who notices an unanswered
, an approaching deadline, an incomplete task, or missing information—and takes initiative to move it forward.

You’ll work directly with the executive while also providing administrative and operational support to members of the Leadership Team.

The position will initially average approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities over time. For the right person, this role could eventually grow into a full-time Practice Manager or Operations role.



What You’ll Do

Executive Support

Help keep the executive organized, informed, and focused on the highest-priority work.

Responsibilities may include:

Monitor and organize designated executive
 inboxes

Identify
s, documents, and requests requiring attention

Draft
 responses for executive review and approval

Flag urgent or high-priority items

Track
s and requests requiring follow-up

Independently follow up on routine matters when appropriate

Manage and coordinate calendars

Schedule meetings and identify potential scheduling conflicts

Prepare meeting agendas and supporting materials

Take meeting notes and document decisions

Create and maintain follow-up action items

Maintain executive task and priority lists

Organize files, records, and documentation

Assist with recurring administrative responsibilities

You will initially draft executive communications rather than sending responses on the executive’s behalf. As you learn the businesses and demonstrate good judgment, your responsibilities may expand.

Leadership Team Support

Provide administrative and operational support to members of the Leadership Team and help ensure important priorities continue moving forward.



Responsibilities may include:

Monitor deadlines and priorities through Zoho and other company systems

Review weekly Service Level Agreement (SLA) reports

Identify significant trends, exceptions, overdue items, or potential problems

Prepare concise summaries for leadership

Run and distribute weekly KPI and operational reports

Track Leadership Team projects and action items

Follow up with team members regarding outstanding responsibilities

Identify missing information or discrepancies and help resolve them

Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting materials

Assist with CRM updates and data management

Document processes and create or update SOPs

Assist Leadership Team members with administrative and operational projects

Communicate professionally with leadership, operations staff, tax advisors, senior management, and clients as needed

Escalate issues appropriately when leadership attention is required

Marketing Operations

Approximately 30% of the position will generally support our digital marketing agency, although the allocation between businesses will vary based on workload.

You do not need to be an SEO expert, Google Ads specialist, or web developer. However, some familiarity with digital marketing is helpful.

Your primary responsibility is helping make sure projects stay organized, deadlines are met, and our specialists follow through.

Responsibilities may include:

Follow up with SEO, PPC, website, and other marketing team members

Monitor project deadlines and recurring deliverables

Review task completion and identify overdue work

Coordinate with overseas contractors

Check client websites for obvious issues

Perform basic quality-control reviews before work is delivered

Prepare and organize client reports

Maintain CRM and client information

Assist with LinkedIn and other social media posting

Perform basic website or content updates

Assist with Canva, photo editing, and other simple marketing tasks

Track recurring client and marketing responsibilities

Follow up when deliverables are incomplete or behind schedule

Assist with miscellaneous marketing projects as needed

You don’t need to know how to perform every task yourself. You do need to be comfortable asking questions, learning how the work should be completed, checking that it was completed, and following up when it wasn’t.

General Operations & Special Projects

Because this role supports growing businesses, no two weeks will look exactly the same.



You may also assist with:

Research

Data entry

Report preparation

Spreadsheet organization

CRM maintenance

SOP documentation

Website updates

Photo and document organization

Project coordination

Client or prospect follow-up

Process improvement

Quality-control checks

Miscellaneous administrative and operational projects



Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate doesn’t simply wait for a list of tasks each morning.

We’re looking for someone who:

Thinks several steps ahead

Is proactive rather than reactive

Loves organization and creating order

Notices details other people miss

Has exceptional follow-through

Is comfortable reminding others about deadlines and commitments

Can identify when something doesn’t look right and investigate further

Writes excellent English

Communicates professionally with U.S.-based team members and clients

Is comfortable asking questions when information is missing

Can prioritize competing responsibilities

Learns new software quickly

Can work independently without constant supervision

Understands when to handle something independently and when to escalate it

Is dependable and responsive during assigned working hours

Can handle confidential client and company information with discretion

Enjoys improving processes rather than simply following them



Qualifications

Required

Approximately 2–3+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, operations, project coordination, customer service, or a similar role

Excellent written English

Strong verbal English communication skills

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Excellent attention to detail

Experience managing
, calendars, tasks, and deadlines

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Comfortable working U.S. Central Time hours

Comfortable learning new technology and systems

A college degree is not required.

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

Zoho CRM or Zoho One

Microsoft Office

Google Workspace

Canva

WordPress

ChatGPT or other AI tools

Project management systems

Digital marketing

SEO or Google Ads

Website management

Supporting U.S.-based executives or businesses

Tax, accounting, or professional-services firms

We care more about your ability to learn, communicate, organize, and follow through than whether you already know every system we use.



Schedule

This is a remote, part-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week, although weekly hours will vary based on business needs.

The typical schedule will include:

Availability approximately 7:00–9:00 AM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday

An additional 1–2 flexible hours per day based on workload

Occasional additional availability as projects or deadlines require

Our tax and accounting business is seasonal.

Hours will typically increase during:

January through April

September and October

During the primary tax season, you should expect at least 10 additional hours per week, and there may be opportunities to work up to full-time hours depending on workload and your availability.

We will communicate significant seasonal schedule changes in advance whenever possible.



Compensation

Starting pay: $5.00 USD/hour

There is opportunity for:

Increased compensation based on performance and expanded responsibilities

Performance bonuses

Additional hours

Increased responsibility

Long-term advancement within the organization

Growth Opportunity

We’re not simply looking for someone to complete a list of administrative tasks.

We’re looking for someone who can become increasingly valuable to the businesses over time.

As you learn our team, clients, systems, and processes, there will be opportunities to take ownership of additional responsibilities and increase your hours and compensation.

For the right person, this role has the potential to develop from Executive Operations Coordinator into a Practice Manager or broader Operations Management position.



What Success Looks Like

You’ll be successful in this role when:

Important
s and requests don’t get forgotten

Leadership knows what requires attention before it becomes urgent

Meetings result in clear action items and follow-through

Reports are accurate and delivered on time

Deadlines are monitored without leadership constantly checking them

Team members receive appropriate follow-up on outstanding tasks

Marketing projects continue moving forward

Missing information and potential problems are identified early

Systems and documentation become more organized over time



The executive and Leadership Team spend less time tracking administrative details because they trust you to keep things moving

Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who sees what needs to happen next—and helps make sure it happens.

title: Document Management Assistant
description:
​Position SummaryProvide efficient, courteous, and personalized service to professional tax 

advisors, operations department, senior management, and current clients by effectively 

interfacing with those assigned to provide these services. Serve as an administrative assistant 

to ensure daily tasks and objectives are completed with exceptional accuracy and high-

performance standards. Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

●Sorting and organizing documents received from clients, including engagement letters, 

intake questionnaires, and tax documents. 

●Making outbound calls to follow up with clients regarding document submissions. 

●Communicating effectively with staff. 

●Using CRM and Microsoft Office programs. 

●Checking the shared work drive for client document uploads. 

●Processing uploaded documents according to project needs. 

●Creating projects in the CRM. 

●Checking calendar for accuracy and managing calendar entries. 

●Notifying clients of project completion. 

●Managing document storage in CRM. 

●Running and correcting CRM database integrity reports to filter and fix possible errors. 

●Managing
 accounts. 

●Meeting with the Operations team to discuss work and strategize. 

●Other tasks as assigned (e.g., CRM audits, data reports, preparing reports). 



Between 10-40 hours weekly from 

April 16 to January 31 and 40+ hours from February 1 to April 15) 

​

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesTo perform this job successfully, an individual must be 

able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable 

accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential 

functions. 

●Advanced Customer Service. 

●Scheduling and resolving conflicts. 

●Effective follow-up. 

●Time Management. 

●Maintaining optimal work performance in a fast-paced environment is a primary 

responsibility in this role. 

●Relationship management is essential to make the client feel welcome and significant, 

either on the phone or in person. 

●Maintain flexibility to effectively transition between critical workstations within the 

Operations Department. 

●Ability to effectively identify process improvement opportunities for the Operations 

Departments. 

●Familiarity with a variety of tax, accounting, and financial services concepts, practices, 

and procedures. 

●A wide range of creativity and latitude is expected. 

​

Core ValuesTo perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following 

core values: 

●Services Client Above All Else: Cares about client success, is friendly, treats everyone 

with respect, understands the value of reputation, and encourages teamwork with 

clients. 

●Does the Right Thing: Hard worker, willingness, integrity, shows honesty. 

●Shows Unequivocal Excellence: Takes responsibility, maintains accountability, values 

a collaborative environment, willing to teach, train, and expound. 

●Questions to Solve: Continues to strive for perfection, detail-oriented, pragmatic, 

creative, values accuracy. 

​

QualificationsTo perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each 

essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, 

skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals 

with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

​

Education/Experience:High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and three to 

five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and 

experience. Some college preferred. 

​

Language Ability:Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and 

maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and 

correspondence. Ability to speak effectively in English on the phone or before groups of 

customers or employees of an organization.

title: Land Acquisitions Coordinator – Seller Calls, SMS & Builder Outreach
description:
LAND ACQUISITION OPERATIONS & EXECUTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — FULL-TIME



Starting Pay: $4.00 USD/hour + Performance & Deal Bonuses

Hours: 40 hours/week with opportunity for up to approximately 50 hours/week

Location: Philippines — Remote

Schedule: Substantial availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours required

Position: Full-Time, Long-Term



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VA POSITION



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company seeking an exceptional, experienced full-time Virtual Assistant to join our vacant-land acquisition team.



We will be very particular about this hire because the candidate will be trusted with important parts of our business.



We are not looking for someone who waits to be given another task.



We are looking for an intelligent, highly organized, proactive professional who can take ownership, communicate consistently, solve problems, learn quickly, improve processes, and help keep a fast-moving real estate acquisition business operating smoothly.



The ideal person naturally thinks:



“I understand what we’re trying to accomplish. What needs to happen next?”



Previous experience supporting a U.S. real estate investor, wholesaling company, land investor, acquisitions team, or other real estate investment company is strongly preferred.



Direct experience with vacant land will receive special consideration.



We are also very interested in candidates who bring knowledge to the table. If you have worked inside a successful real estate investment operation and know systems, tools, processes, or strategies that could make our company more efficient, we want to hear your ideas and learn from your experience.



WHAT YOU MAY BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Seller SMS, Lead Management & Follow-Up



Speed and consistency of seller communication are extremely important to our business.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring incoming seller SMS/text responses

* Responding promptly during working hours

* Maintaining professional, natural conversations with U.S. property owners

* Answering routine seller questions using approved information and SOPs

* Gathering seller motivation and property information

* Following up consistently with sellers

* Making sure promising conversations do not sit unanswered

* Identifying motivated sellers

* Escalating negotiations or serious situations appropriately

* Recording conversations and next steps

* Maintaining accurate follow-up dates



You will receive clear guidance regarding what you are authorized to handle independently and what should be escalated.



We do not expect you to guess. We do expect you to communicate.



CRM & Acquisition Pipeline



We want our CRM to be a reliable source of truth.



Responsibilities may include:



* Entering and updating seller leads.

* Maintaining accurate lead stages

* Recording seller conversations

* Creating and monitoring follow-up tasks

* Tracking offers and negotiations

* Tracking contracts and deadlines

* Identifying stale leads

* Flagging high-priority opportunities

* Maintaining pipeline reports

* Making sure opportunities never fall through the cracks



Property Research & Acquisitions Support



Responsibilities may include:



* Researching parcels and property owners

* Reviewing county and assessor records

* Confirming property characteristics

* Researching comparable properties

* Assisting with pricing research

* Researching builders and potential buyers

* Assisting with property due diligence

* Organizing property information for review

* Tracking offers, contracts, and closings



Campaigns, Lists & Data



You may assist with:



* Preparing seller lists

* Cleaning and organizing data

* Excel and Google Sheets

* Skip tracing

* Direct-mail campaigns

* SMS campaigns

* Campaign tracking

* Suppression/contact records

* Lead-source tracking

* Campaign reporting and performance



Transaction & Closing Support



As responsibilities grow, you may also:



* Maintain transaction checklists

* Track contract deadlines

* Coordinate documents

* Communicate with title companies and other parties.

* Maintain organized transaction files.

* Track properties from contract through closing

* Assist with resale/disposition activities.



Executive & Operational Support



This position may grow beyond basic land administration.



The right person may also:



* Maintain task and project lists.

* Organize priorities and deadlines.

* Follow up with vendors and team members.

* Maintain dashboards and reports.

* Create and improve SOPs.

* Research software and operational solutions

* Help implement new systems.

* Identify repetitive tasks that the company should automate.

* Use AI to improve efficiency.

* Keep projects moving without repeated reminders.

* Help organize and eventually train additional team members as we grow.



EXPERIENCE WE VALUE



Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:



* U.S. real estate investing

* Vacant land investing

* Land acquisitions

* Real estate wholesaling

* Off-market acquisitions

* Seller lead management

* Seller SMS/text conversations

* CRM/pipeline management

* Direct-mail campaigns

* SMS campaigns

* Skip tracing

* Property research

* County/assessor research

* Comparable-property research

* Due diligence

* Offer preparation

* Contracts

* Title/closing coordination

* Dispositions

* Builder/buyer research

* Transaction coordination



TECHNOLOGY & AI



You should be comfortable with technology and learning new systems.



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



* Real estate CRMs

* SMS platforms

* Google Workspace

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Property research platforms

* County websites

* Skip-tracing platforms

* Project-management systems

* Canva

* Automation tools



You do not need experience with every platform we use.



What matters is your ability to learn quickly, research solutions independently, and bring useful knowledge from your previous experience.



If you know a better way to accomplish something, we want you to speak up.



FULL-TIME AVAILABILITY



This is a dedicated full-time position.



We require 40 hours per week, with the option to work up to approximately 50 hours per week when needed and mutually agreed upon.



Because seller communication is an important part of this role, substantial availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.



Please disclose any other ongoing clients or employment during the application process.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company.



HOW WE WORK — PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY



This is an important, high-trust position. We want you to understand the type of working relationship and company culture we are building from the beginning.



We Don’t Micromanage — We Expect Ownership



We are looking for capable professionals who can be trusted with larger responsibilities.



Our goal is not to monitor your every move, repeatedly remind you about tasks, or tell you what to do every hour of the day.



We provide expectations, goals, systems, training, and support — and then we trust you to execute.



If you see something that needs attention, speak up.



If you know a better way to accomplish something, tell us.



If your previous experience has taught you a system, tool, or process that could improve our company, we want to learn from you.



We are hiring you for your judgment, initiative, and experience, not simply your ability to complete a checklist.



We Operate as a Team



Titles do not determine how much respect someone receives here.



Whether someone is an owner, assistant, contractor, vendor, or future team member, everyone is expected to treat one another with the same level of professionalism and respect.



No one on this team is “better” than anyone else.



We have ambitious goals, and we want people who enjoy working together to achieve them.



We are building something successful as a team.



Communication Is Extremely Important



We value frequent, clear, proactive communication.



If you’re unsure — ask.



If you see a problem — raise it.



If someone might miss a deadline — tell us before it is missed.



If you make a mistake — tell us.



If you disagree or believe there is a better solution — respectfully speak up.



If something requires the owner’s attention — escalate it.



Good news should be communicated. Bad news should be communicated even faster.



We would always rather know what’s happening than discover a problem later because someone was uncomfortable bringing it to our attention.



Honesty Is Non-Negotiable



Because this position involves significant trust, 100% honesty is required.



Mistakes happen. We understand that.



We would much rather hear:



“I made a mistake. Here’s exactly what happened, here’s what I’ve done to fix it, and here’s how I’ll prevent it from happening again.”



Then have someone hide a mistake because they’re worried about the reaction.



Most operational problems can be solved when we know about them.



Trust for this candidate cannot be built without honesty.



Autonomy Comes With Accountability



Working without micromanagement comes with responsibility.



We expect you to:



* Keep your commitments

* Communicate proactively

* Follow through without repeated reminders.

* Take ownership of your responsibilities.

* Admit mistakes quickly

* Ask questions when necessary.

* Protect confidential company information.

* Treat everyone professionally

* Look for solutions rather than excuses.

* Care about company results, not simply completing your hours.



In return, you can expect respect, professionalism, fairness, appreciation, clear communication, and recognition for excellent performance.



COMPENSATION, BONUSES & GROWTH



Starting compensation is $4.00 USD/hour.



Excellent performance should be rewarded.



There will be opportunities for:



* Performance-based raises

* Goal and milestone bonuses

* Bonuses associated with successful real estate transactions

* Additional hours when needed

* Increased responsibility

* Increased compensation as your role grows

* Future leadership opportunities



We have ambitious growth goals for this company.



As deal volume increases, we expect to add additional team members and Virtual Assistants.



The right first hire creates a significant opportunity.



Someone who proves themselves may eventually grow from a Virtual Assistant into a senior operations role, a lead VA role, or a team management role, helping to train and coordinate future team members.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for the long term.



We are not looking for someone who simply clocks in, completes the minimum requirements, and disappears.



We want someone who gets excited about helping build something.



When the company wins, we want the people who helped create those wins to share in the success.



CONFIDENTIALITY, NDA & COMPANY INFORMATION



This is a high-trust position that may provide access to valuable confidential and proprietary business information.



The successful candidate will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure/Confidentiality Agreement (NDA) and other appropriate agreements protecting company information, intellectual property, work product, relationships, systems, and proprietary processes before receiving access to confidential company systems or information.



Confidential information may include:



* Seller and property-owner information

* Lead lists and databases

* Property data

* Acquisition markets and criteria

* Pricing and offer strategies

* Seller conversations and negotiations

* Buyer and builder relationships

* Campaign information and performance

* CRM data

* Marketing strategies

* SOPs

* Internal processes and workflows

* Automations and AI systems

* Proprietary prompts, templates, tools, and technology

* Company-created spreadsheets, dashboards, and documents

* Transaction and financial information

* Other non-public company information



Company information, data, systems, processes, relationships, and intellectual property may not be copied, retained, disclosed, sold, transferred, or repurposed for another person or business except as expressly authorized.



Professional discretion, confidentiality, and trust are mandatory for this position.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY



Attention to detail is extremely important.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



1. Start Your Application With:



“I READ EVERYTHING — LAND IS MY JAM.”



2. Tell Us About Your Experience



Please include:



* Total years working as a Virtual Assistant

* Years supporting U.S. companies

* Years supporting U.S. real estate companies

* Types of real estate investors/companies you supported

* Whether you have direct vacant-land experience



3. Tell Us What You Personally Did



Describe your actual responsibilities in your most relevant U.S. real estate position.



We want to understand what you personally handled, not simply what the company did.



4. Seller Communication



Tell us about your experience communicating with U.S. property owners through SMS, phone, and/or
.



Have you personally managed seller conversations and ongoing follow-up?



5. Systems



List the CRMs, SMS platforms, real estate tools, property-research systems, skip-tracing platforms, project-management tools, spreadsheet programs, and AI tools you have personally used.



Briefly tell us what you used each one for.



6. Land/Acquisition Experience



If applicable, tell us which portions of this process you have personally handled:



List → Outreach → Seller Response → Follow-Up → Research → Offer → Negotiation → Contract → Closing → Disposition



7. Problem Solving



Give us one real example of a process you improved for a previous employer.



What was the problem?



What did you recommend?



What happened as a result?



8. Honesty & Accountability



Tell us about a real mistake you made at work that affected an employer or client.



What happened?



When did you tell them?



How did you fix it?



What did you change afterward to prevent it from happening again?



9. Prioritization Exercise



Imagine that you have all of the following happening at once:



* 25 unanswered seller responses

* 3 contracts approaching deadlines

* A campaign launching tomorrow

* 2 vendors waiting for answers

* 50 CRM records requiring updates

* An urgent property report requested by the owner



Tell us exactly how you would prioritize these responsibilities and why.



10. Availability



Please provide:



* Your desired hourly rate

* Hours available each week

* Availability during U.S. Eastern Time

* Any other clients or employment you currently have

* Whether you are comfortable working 40 hours per week, with additional hours potentially available



11. Video Introduction



Please provide a link to a 60–90-second video introduction.



Tell us:



* Who you are

* Your most relevant U.S. real estate experience

* Your vacant-land experience, if applicable

* Why do you believe you would be exceptional in this position



Please do not read from a prepared script.



12. AI & Technology



Give us one specific example of how you have used ChatGPT, AI, automation, or another technology to save an employer time or improve a business process.



13. One Final Detail



At the very bottom of your application, tell us:



Your favorite food + the last software program you taught yourself to use.



ONE LAST THING



This application is intentionally more detailed than most VA applications.



We aren’t looking to fill a seat with the first available person.



We are looking for the right person.



If you are experienced, highly organized, technologically proficient, honest, proactive, comfortable taking ownership, and excited about joining a growing U.S. real estate investment company where exceptional performance is recognized and rewarded, we would genuinely like to hear from you.



Qualified applicants will be contacted quickly for interviews.

title: Video Editing, Shorts and Youtube Videos
description:
Video Editor – YouTube & Drone Sound Design



We are hiring a full-time video editor to create short-form and long-form YouTube content, including cinematic Alaska flying, outdoor, wildlife, and adventure videos.



Starting pay: 50,000 PHP/month



We recommend applicants have at least 2 years of experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Editing must be completed using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut only.



A major part of the position will involve adding realistic sound design to drone footage so it sounds as though the drone actually recorded audio on location, including:



- Rivers, waterfalls, wind, birds, and wildlife

- Fish jumping or splashing

title: Bookkeeping Client Support Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Bookkeeping Client Support Coordinator to help our bookkeeping team collect, organize, and process information needed to complete client bookkeeping projects accurately and on time.



A major part of bookkeeping is making sure we have the right information from the client. Bank statements may be missing. Transactions may need clarification. Accounts may need access. Receipts or supporting documents may still be outstanding.



Your job is to help make sure those missing pieces don’t cause projects to sit still.



You will work closely with our bookkeeping team to identify outstanding information, communicate with clients by
, text, and phone, track responses, organize documents as they are received, and continue following up until the bookkeeping team has what it needs to move forward.



This is not simply a data-entry position.



We’re looking for someone who is comfortable communicating with clients, understands basic bookkeeping concepts, follows established processes carefully, and takes ownership of making sure assigned items reach completion.



What You’ll Do



Client Follow-Up & Missing Information



A primary responsibility of this position is helping obtain information needed to complete client bookkeeping.



Responsibilities may include:



* Review bookkeeping projects for missing documents or outstanding client questions

* Contact clients by
, text, and phone to request missing information

* Clearly explain what information or documentation is needed

* Follow up consistently when clients do not respond

* Track outstanding requests and client responses

* Document communication and follow-up activity in company systems

* Identify when information received is incomplete or does not match what was requested

* Ask appropriate follow-up questions when clarification is needed

* Escalate difficult, unusual, or time-sensitive situations to the bookkeeping team

* Help prevent bookkeeping projects from becoming stalled because of missing client information



You should be comfortable being politely persistent. A single unanswered
 should not mean the request is forgotten.



Bookkeeping Document Processing



As information comes in from clients, you will help make sure it is processed accurately and efficiently.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitor designated systems for newly received client documents

* Download, organize, rename, and store documents according to company procedures

* Identify bank statements, credit card statements, loan statements, payroll reports, receipts, and other bookkeeping records

* Confirm requested documents have been received

* Identify missing statement periods or incomplete documentation

* Upload and organize documents within the appropriate client records and projects

* Update project statuses as information is received

* Notify bookkeeping team members when requested information is available

* Maintain accurate client files and documentation

* Follow established workflows for handling client information

* Perform basic quality-control checks before marking tasks complete



Accuracy is extremely important. Documents must be associated with the correct client, account, period, and project.



Bookkeeping & Transaction Support



This role does not require you to be an experienced accountant, but you should understand basic bookkeeping concepts and be comfortable learning more.



Depending on experience and training, responsibilities may include:



* Assist with identifying or researching uncategorized transactions

* Send clients transaction clarification questions

* Organize client responses for the bookkeeping team

* Identify transactions that require additional documentation

* Assist with basic transaction coding or data entry

* Review account activity for obvious missing information

* Help reconcile client responses with outstanding bookkeeping questions

* Identify potential duplicates, missing transactions, or unusual discrepancies

* Assist with other routine bookkeeping support tasks



You are not expected to independently resolve complex accounting issues. You are expected to recognize when something is missing, follow the appropriate process, and ask for help when something does not make sense.



Project & Workflow Management



An important part of this role is making sure projects continue moving forward.



You may be responsible for:



* Monitor assigned bookkeeping projects and outstanding items

* Maintain lists of missing information and client requests

* Review projects regularly to determine what is preventing completion

* Follow established follow-up schedules

* Update CRM and project-management systems accurately

* Identify overdue or stalled projects

* Communicate project status with bookkeeping team members

* Follow up internally when action is needed from another team member

* Escalate projects that require additional attention

* Help ensure monthly, quarterly, and catch-up bookkeeping projects stay on schedule



We don’t want projects sitting untouched because everyone assumed someone else was following up.



Team Collaboration



You will work closely with bookkeepers, tax professionals, operations staff, and other team members.



Strong communication and teamwork are essential.



You should be comfortable:



* Asking bookkeepers what information they need from a client

* Translating internal bookkeeping requests into clear client-friendly communication

* Providing concise updates on outstanding items

* Asking questions when instructions are unclear

* Receiving feedback and adjusting quickly

* Following established processes even when managing many different clients

* Helping teammates identify bottlenecks or recurring problems

* Suggesting process improvements when you see opportunities to make the workflow more efficient



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys getting things completed.



You don’t need to know everything about accounting, but you should be naturally organized, persistent, and detail-oriented.



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has exceptional attention to detail

* Is organized and process-oriented

* Has strong follow-through

* Is comfortable communicating with clients

* Writes clear, professional English

* Speaks English confidently on the phone

* Is comfortable making outbound client calls

* Can politely but consistently follow up with clients

* Understands basic bookkeeping terminology

* Can recognize when information appears incomplete or inconsistent

* Follows established procedures carefully

* Keeps accurate notes and records

* Can manage many small outstanding items without losing track of them

* Works well as part of a remote team

* Is comfortable asking questions rather than making assumptions

* Can distinguish between something they can resolve and something that should be escalated

* Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities

* Is dependable and responsive during scheduled working hours



Qualifications



Required



* At least 1–2 years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, administrative support, customer service, or a related role

* Basic understanding of bookkeeping and accounting concepts

* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience communicating professionally with customers or clients

* Comfortable communicating through
, text, and phone

* Ability to follow detailed processes and procedures

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Comfortable learning new technology and systems



A college degree is not required.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* Bookkeeping or accounting firms

* Bank and credit card reconciliations

* Transaction categorization

* Financial statements

* Zoho CRM or Zoho One

* Microsoft Office

* Google Workspace

* Client document-management systems

* Project-management or workflow software

* Supporting U.S.-based businesses or clients

* Tax or professional-services firms



We care more about accuracy, communication, follow-through, and willingness to learn than whether you already know every system we use.



What Success Looks Like



You’ll be successful in this role when:



* Bookkeeping projects don’t sit unnecessarily because information is missing

* Clients clearly understand what we need from them

* Outstanding requests receive consistent follow-up

* Documents are processed accurately and promptly when received

* Missing statement periods and incomplete information are caught early

* Client responses are documented and communicated to the bookkeeping team

* Bookkeepers spend less time chasing documents and client answers

* Project statuses accurately reflect what is happening

* Team members know which projects are waiting on clients and which are ready to move forward

* Established processes are followed consistently

* Errors and discrepancies are identified before they create larger problems

* Clients receive friendly, professional communication throughout the bookkeeping process



Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who takes ownership of the space between “we need something from the client” and “the bookkeeping team has everything they need to continue.”



Your role is to help close that gap quickly, accurately, and professionally.
